title: Police officer dies and another injured after backpack explosion in Oviedo
english: A police officer was killed and another seriously wounded in Oviedo, Spain, when an explosive device hidden in a backpack detonated while they were inspecting it. The incident followed a reported neighborhood dispute that left a woman suffering from gunshot wounds. Authorities are currently conducting a major manhunt for the suspect who fled the area.
amharic: በስፔን ኦቪዬዶ ከተማ የፖሊስ አባላት አጠራጣሪ ቦርሳን ለመመርመር በሞከሩበት ወቅት በተፈጠረ የቦምብ ፍንዳታ አንድ የፖሊስ አባል ሲሞት ሌላኛው ደግሞ ከባድ ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። ይህ ክስተት የተፈጠረው በጎረቤቶች መካከል በተፈጠረ ግጭት የተኩስ ድርጊት ከተፈጸመ በኋላ ነው። ተጠርጣሪው ከቦታው አምልጦ አሁንም በፖሊስ እየተፈለገ ይገኛል።
oromo: Magaalaal Oviyeedoo kan Ispeen keessatti, poolisonni boorsaa shakkamaa tokko qorachaa jiran utuu jiranii baor-qophiin tokko dhohee poolisii tokko ajjeese, kan biraa ammoo cimaa miidheera. Dhiheenya kana walitti bu'iinsa ollaa gidduutti uumameen dubartii tokko irratti dhukaasni erga raawwatamee booda poolisoonni iddoo sanatti argaman turan. Shakkamichi iddoo sana irraa kan badde yoo ta'u, poolisoonni amma iyyuu isa sakatta'aa jiru.

title: 'Cruise for life' ship seized in Singapore
english: A long-term global cruise ship called The Odyssey has been seized by authorities in Singapore following its operator's financial collapse. The company, Villa Vie Residences, suddenly halted operations last month, leaving approximately 200 passengers stranded in Cambodia. The vessel, which was intended to sail for three years visiting 150 countries, remains in Singapore under a court order while creditors handle the crew's wellbeing.
amharic: ዘ ኦዲሲ የተሰኘው ዓለም አቀፍ የሽርሽር መርከብ፣ ኦፕሬተሩ በገጠመው የገንዘብ ችግር ምክንያት በሲንጋፖር ባለስልጣናት ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል። ቪላ ቪ ረዚደንሲስ የተባለው ኩባንያ ካለፈው ወር ጀምሮ ስራውን በማቆሙ በካምቦዲያ የነበሩ ወደ 200 የሚጠጉ ተሳፋሪዎች ተጉላተዋል። ለሶስት አመታት 150 ሀገራትን ለመጎብኘት ታቅዶ የነበረው ይህ መርከብ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በፍርድ ቤት ትእዛዝ በሲንጋፖር ወደብ ታግቶ የሚገኝ ሲሆን የሰራተኞቹ ሁኔታ በአበዳሪዎች እየተጣራ ነው።
oromo: Markabni 'The Odyssey' jedhamu kan ganna sadii guutuu addunyaa naanna'uuf karoorfate, rakkoo faayinaansii dhaabbata isaa irraa kan ka'e Singappooritti qabamee jira. Dhaabbatichi 'Villa Vie Residences' jedhamu ji'a darbe hojii isaa dhaabuun isaa, imaltoota 200 ta'an Kaamboodiyaatti rakkoo keessa akka galan taasiseera. Markabichi amma abbaa taayitaa Singappoorin ajaja mana murtiitiin kan qabame yoo ta'u, gaaffiin nageenyaa fi walitti dhufeenyi hojjettootaa immoo abbootii qabeenyaa biraan qulqullaa'aa jira.

title: Humanoid robot takes on Antarctic ultra-marathon… and fails
english: A humanoid robot attempted to complete an ultra-marathon in the harsh environment of Antarctica. However, the machine was unsuccessful in finishing the demanding race. The attempt highlighted the significant challenges technology faces when operating in extreme polar conditions.
amharic: አንድ ሰውን መሰል ሮቦት በአንታርክቲካ አስቸጋሪ የአየር ንብረት ውስጥ የአልትራ ማራቶን ውድድር ለመጨረስ ሙከራ አድርጎ ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ ሮቦቱ ውድድሩን ማጠናቀቅ አልቻለም። ይህ ሙከራ ቴክኖሎጂ በከባድ የበረዶ አካባቢዎች ሲሰራ የሚያጋጥሙትን ከፍተኛ ተግዳሮቶች የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Roobotiin bifa namaa qabu tokko naannoo Antarktiikaa keessatti fiigicha dheeraa (ultra-marathon) xumuruuf yaalii godhee ture. Haa ta'u malee, roobotiin sun fiigicha sana xumuruu hin dandeenye. Yaalii kun teeknooloojiin haala qilleensa cimaa fi qabbanaa'aa ta'e keessatti hojjechuun hangam ulfaataa akka ta'e kan mul'isu dha.

title: UK author M John Harrison’s End of Everything wins Booker Prize
english: British author M. John Harrison has won the 2026 Booker Prize for his dystopian novel, The End of Everything. At 81 years old, he is the oldest person to ever receive this prestigious award for his story about life in Britain following a mysterious global catastrophe. The judges praised the work as a unique blend of genres that captures the uncertainty of modern times.
amharic: ብሪታንያዊው ደራሲ ኤም ጆን ሃሪሰን በ2026 የቡከር ሽልማትን በ‹‹ዘ ኤንድ ኦፍ ኤቭሪቲንግ›› በተሰኘው የዲስቶፒያን ልብወለድ መጽሐፋቸው አሸንፈዋል። በ81 ዓመታቸው የዚህን ክብር ያገኙ ትልቁ ሰው በመሆን ታሪክ ሰርተዋል፤ መጽሐፉም እንግዳ በሆነ ዓለም አቀፋዊ አደጋ የተጎዳች ብሪታንያን ያሳያል። ዳኞቹ መጽሐፉን ወቅታዊ አለመረጋጋትን በልዩ የጽሁፍ ዘይቤ የሚገልጽ ድንቅ ስራ ሲሉ አወድሰውታል።
oromo: barreessaan biyya Ingiliz M. John Harrison bu'uura barreeffama isaanii 'The End of Everything' jedhamuun badhaasa Booker Prize bara 2026 injifataniiru. Umriin isaanii waggaa 81 ta'uun, nama badhaasa kana fudhate keessaa isa hangafa ta'aniiru. Labseewwan isaanis badhaasichi balaa addunyaa irra ga'e booda biyya Ingiliz keessatti jireenya haala kamin akka jiru kan ibsuufi haala yeroo ammaa kanaa kan calaqqisu ta'uu ibsaniiru.

title: Pakistan TV anchor allegedly shot dead at home by her husband
english: Pakistani television presenter Rabiya Ahsan was killed after being shot in her home. Her husband is currently the primary suspect in the incident. Police are now conducting an investigation to verify the husband's claim that the shooting was unintentional.
amharic: የፓኪስታኗ የቴሌቪዥን ጋዜጠኛ ረቢያ አህሳን በቤቷ ውስጥ በጥይት ተመትታ መሞቷ ተገልጿል። ባለቤቷ ለዚህ ግድያ ዋና ተጠርጣሪ ሆኗል። ባለቤቷ ድርጊቱ በአጋጣሚ የተፈጠረ ነው በማለት የሰጠውን ቃል ለማጣራት ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Gaazexeessituun televizhinii Paakistaan Rabiiyaa Ahsaan mana ishee keessatti rasaasaan rukutamtee lubbuun ishee darbeera. Abbaan manaa ishee ajjeechaa kana keessatti shakkamaa guddaa ta'eera. Ajjeechaan kun tasa kan uumame ta'uu isaatiin ibsa abbaan manaa ishee kenne mirkaneeffachuuf qorannoon geggeeffamaa jira.

title: What is Hasina’s game plan as she seeks a passport to return to Bangladesh?
english: Former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is seeking a new passport to return home from exile in India, despite being sentenced to death for her role in the violent crackdown on 2024 protests. The current Bangladeshi government has denied her request and warned that she will face execution if she returns. Analysts suggest that Hasina may be using this public bid to maintain political relevance rather than genuinely intending to face legal consequences.
amharic: የባንግላዲሽ የቀድሞ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ ሀሲና በ2024 በተነሳው ተቃውሞ ወቅት በተፈጸመው ግድያ የሞት ፍርድ ተፈርዶባቸው በህንድ በስደት ላይ ቢሆኑም ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ ፓስፖርት እየጠየቁ ነው። የአሁኑ የባንግላዲሽ መንግስት ጥያቄያቸውን ውድቅ ያደረገ ሲሆን ወደ ሀገር ከተመለሱ የሞት ፍርዱ እንደሚፈጸምባቸው አስጠንቅቋል። ተንታኞች እንደሚሉት ሀሲና ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰዱት በፖለቲካው ዓለም ያላቸውን ተጽዕኖ ለማስቀጠል እንጂ በእርግጥ ለህግ ለመቅረብ ላይሆን ይችላል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa biyyattii duraanii Sheikh Hasina, bara 2024 hiriira mormii irratti ajjeechaa raawwatameef adabbii du'aa itti murteeffamee osoo jiruu, biyyattiitti deebi'uuf paaspoortii gaafachaa jiru. Mootummaan ammaa gaaffii isaanii kana kan dide yoo ta'u, biyyattiitti deebi'an adabbiin du'aa irratti raawwatama jedheera. Hayyoonni akka ibsanitti, Hasina tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatan seeratti dhiyaachuuf utuu hin taane, siyaasa keessatti iddoo qabaachuufi deeggarsa isaanii jajjabeessuuf ta'uu mala.

title: Nvidia spy scandal fuels debate over chip exports to China
english: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is facing a corporate investigation following reports that he had an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent. This scandal has intensified pressure from US lawmakers to implement stricter controls on the export of advanced microchips to China. While Huang previously lobbied against such restrictions, his current situation has triggered both internal company reviews and an FBI inquiry regarding potential national security risks.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት ነበራቸው በሚል የቀረበውን ክስ ተከትሎ ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ይገኛል። ይህ ክስተት አሜሪካ ለቻይና የምትልካቸውን ዘመናዊ ቺፖች ለመቆጣጠር በህግ አውጪዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ግፊት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል። ቀደም ሲል የቴክኖሎጂ ኤክስፖርት ገደቦችን በመቃወም ይታወቁ የነበሩት ሁአንግ፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በኩባንያው እና በኤፍቢአይ (FBI) የሀገር ደህንነት ስጋት ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Nvidia Jensen Huang, dubartii garee basaastota Chaayinaa keessa jirti jedhamtu waliin walitti dhufeenya qabaachuu isaatiin qorannoon irratti banameera. Rakkoon kun, biyyi Ameerikaa teeknoolojii 'chip' (chip) gara Chaayinaatti ergitu irratti dhiibbaa cimaa gochuuf akka isheen tarkaanfii fudhattu godheera. Kanaan dura daldala chip irratti uggurri akka hin jiraanne falmaa turus, amma qorannoon dhaabbatichaa fi kan FBI (FBI) irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru nageenya biyyaalessaa waliin walqabatee yaaddoo guddaa uumeera.

title: Trump says FBI investigating Nvidia boss's affair with alleged Chinese spy
english: President Donald Trump confirmed that the FBI is investigating the CEO of Nvidia, Jensen Huang, due to his romantic relationship with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. While Trump noted that Huang denied any knowledge of the woman's background, the controversy caused Nvidia's stock value to drop significantly. The company is currently conducting its own independent inquiry and insists that its internal secrets and national security interests remain safe.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር በተጠረጠረች ሴት ላይ ባላቸው ግንኙነት ምክንያት የኤፍቢአይ ምርመራ እየተካሄደባቸው መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል። ትራምፕ እንደገለጹት ሁአንግ ስለ ሴትየዋ የስለላ ስራ ምንም እንደማያውቁ ተናግረዋል፣ ነገር ግን ይህ ውዝግብ የኩባንያውን የአክሲዮን ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ እንዲቀንስ አድርጓል። ኩባንያው ጉዳዩን በራሱ በኩል እያጣራ ሲሆን፣ እስካሁን ድረስ ምንም አይነት የደህንነት ስጋት እንዳልተፈጠረ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolnaald Traamp qajeelchi FBI qindeessaa olaanaa dhaabbata Nvidia, Jeensen Huwaang, dubartii basaastuu Chaayinaa taate jedhamtee shakkamtuu tokkoo wajjin hariiroo qabaachuu isaa qorachaa jiraachuu mirkaneessaniiru. Traamp akka jedhanitti, Huwaang waa'ee basaastummaa dubartittii akka hin beekne himanii jiru, ta'us oduun kun gatii aksiyoona dhaabbata Nvidia akka gad-bu'u godhee jira. Dhaabbatichi mataa isaa qorannoo geggeessaa jiruufi hanga ammaa icciitiiwwan dhaabbatichaa ykn nageenyi biyyaa akka hin miidhamne ibsee jira.

title: Ukraine peace talks resume with 'some flexibility' by warring sides, US officials say
english: Representatives from Ukraine, Russia, and the United States are meeting in Abu Dhabi to discuss potential postwar security arrangements. While both countries remain publicly divided over the control of eastern territories, U.S. officials report that both sides have shown some private flexibility. The talks focus on establishing a new security framework, as both nations recognize that territorial disputes cannot be resolved without a broader agreement on long-term safety.
amharic: የዩክሬን፣ የሩሲያ እና የአሜሪካ ተወካዮች ከጦርነት በኋላ ሊኖር ስለሚችለው የጸጥታ ሁኔታ ለመወያየት በአቡ ዳቢ ተገናኝተዋል። ምንም እንኳን ሁለቱ ሀገራት በምስራቅ ግዛቶች ቁጥጥር ጉዳይ በይፋ ቢለያዩም፣ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት ሁለቱም ወገኖች በግል ደረጃ የተወሰነ የመደራደር ፍላጎት ማሳየታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ውይይቶቹ የሚያተኩሩት አዲስ የጸጥታ ማዕቀፍ በመፍጠር ላይ ሲሆን፣ የክልል አለመግባባቶች ያለ ዘላቂ የጸጥታ ስምምነት ሊፈቱ እንደማይችሉ ሁለቱም ወገኖች ተገንዝበዋል።
oromo: Bakka bu'oonni Yukreen, Raashiyaa fi Ameerikaa marii nageenyaa booda ta'uu malu irratti mari'achuuf Abuu Daabii walga'anii jiru. Biyyoonni lamaanuu naannoolee bahaa irratti dhiibbaa mataa isaanii kan qaban ta'us, qondaaltotni Ameerikaa akka jedhanitti gama lamaanuun marii dhuunfaa irratti wal-danda'uun mul'achaa jira. Mariin kun sirna nageenyaa haaraa diriirsuu irratti kan xiyyeeffatu yoo ta'u, rakkoolee daangaa hiikuun malee nageenya gara fuulduraa mirkaneessuun akka hin danda'amne hubatameera.

title: Epstein associate who still runs model agency 'put me in danger' says abuse survivor
english: A woman who was sexually abused by Jeffrey Epstein claims that her former modeling agency president knowingly sent her to his home for photoshoots, placing her in significant danger. While the agency head, Jeff Fuller, previously denied knowledge of these visits, records indicate the agency had extensive financial and professional ties to Epstein. The survivor is now demanding accountability, arguing that the people who were supposed to protect her failed to do so.
amharic: ጄፍሪ ኤፕስታይን የተባለ ግለሰብ በፆታዊ ጥቃት የደረሰባት አንዲት ሞዴል፣ የቀድሞዋ የሞዴሊንግ ኤጀንሲዋ ኃላፊ ሆን ብለው ወደ ኤፕስታይን ቤት እንደላኳት ትናገራለች። የኤጀንሲው ኃላፊ የነበሩት ጄፍ ፉለር ጉዳዩን እንደማያውቁ ቢክዱም፣ ኤጀንሲው ከኤፕስታይን ጋር የቅርብ የገንዘብ እና የሥራ ግንኙነት እንደነበረው ማስረጃዎች ያሳያሉ። ጥቃት የተፈጸመባት ወይዘሮዋ፣ ሊጠብቋት የነበሩ አካላት ኃላፊነታቸውን በመወጣት ረገድ በመውደቃቸው ተጠያቂ መሆን አለባቸው ብላለች።
oromo: Dubartiin tokko Jefrii Episteeniin gudeedamee fi miidhaa irra ga'e, hoogganaan dhaabbata moodeelii ishee kanaan duraa akka beekutti gara mana Episteen erguun ishee balaaf ishee saaxileera jechuun himatte. Haa ta'u malee, hogganaan dhaabbata sanaa Jef Fuuler waa'ee daawwannaa sanaa akka hin beekne yoo dubbatanis, dhaabbatichi Episteen wajjin walitti dhufeenya maallaqaa fi hojii cimaa akka qaban ragaan ni mirkaneessa. Miidhaan irra ga'e kun, qaamoleen ishee eeguu qaban dirqama isaanii bahachuu waan dadhabaniif seera duratti gaafatamu qabu jettee dubbatti.

title: Russia, Ukraine and US to meet as Zelenskyy claims battlefield successes
english: Representatives from Russia and Ukraine are scheduled to meet in Abu Dhabi for US-mediated peace talks. President Zelenskyy claims that recent military victories and heavy Russian losses have improved Ukraine's position, while President Trump suggests that both nations are increasingly motivated to find a resolution. The upcoming meeting aims to advance diplomatic efforts to end the prolonged conflict.
amharic: የሩሲያ እና የዩክሬን ተወካዮች በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት በአቡ ዳቢ ለሰላም ንግግር ለመገናኘት ተዘጋጅተዋል። የዩክሬኑ ፕሬዝዳንት ዘለንስኪ በቅርቡ በጦር ሜዳ ያገኟቸው ድሎች እና የሩሲያ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት የዩክሬንን ድርድር አቅም እንዳጠናከረው ገልጸዋል። ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በበኩላቸው ሁለቱም ወገኖች ግጭቱን ለማቆም ፍላጎት እያሳዩ እንደሆነ የጠቆሙ ሲሆን፣ መጪው ስብሰባ ጦርነቱን ለመፍታት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Bakka bu'oonni Raashiyaa fi Yuukreeniin marii nagaa Ameerikaan gidduu seenteen Abu Daabii keessatti wal arguuf qophaa'aniiru. Prezidaantiin Yuukreen Zeelenskiin injifannoo garraattiirra argamee fi miidhaan Raashiyaarra ga'e Yuukreen marii keessatti qabsoo cimaa akka qabaattu taasiseera jedhan. Prezidaantiin Traamp gamasaaniin, biyyoonni lamaanuu waraana kana xumuruuf fedhii qabaachuu isaanii kan ibsan yoo ta'u, mariin kun furmaata argamsiisuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Cameroon sets date for twice-delayed legislative and local elections
english: Cameroon’s 93-year-old President Paul Biya has scheduled long-overdue legislative and municipal elections for February 7. These polls, which have been postponed twice before, occur amid a climate of political tension and government crackdowns on the opposition. Public concern regarding the president's health and future leadership succession remains high as the country continues to wait for a promised government reshuffle.
amharic: የካሜሩኑ የ93 ዓመት አዛውንት ፕሬዝዳንት ፖል ቢያ፣ ለረጅም ጊዜ ሲዘገዩ የቆዩትን የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት እና የአካባቢ ምርጫዎች ለየካቲት 7 ቀን ቀጠሮ አስይዘዋል። በሁለት ጊዜያት ቀድመው ተራዝመው የነበሩት እነዚህ ምርጫዎች፣ በአሁኑ ወቅት በአገሪቱ በሚታየው ከፍተኛ የፖለቲካ ውጥረት እና በተቃዋሚዎች ላይ የሚወሰደው ጥብቅ እርምጃ በተሞላበት ሁኔታ ውስጥ ይከናወናሉ። የአገሪቱ ሕዝብ በፕሬዝዳንቱ ጤንነት እና በሥልጣን ሽግግር ጉዳይ ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ባለበት ወቅት፣ መንግሥት ቃል ገብቶት የነበረው የአስተዳደር ለውጥ እስካሁን አልተፈጸመም።
oromo: Pireezidaantiin Kaameeruun umurii isaanii waggaa 93 ta'e Pool Biyaa, filannoon seera baastuu fi kan naannoo irra deddeebiin turte sun Guraandhala 7 akka gaggeeffamu labsaniiru. Filannoon kun yeroo lama dura kan dhiibame yoo ta'u, amma kan gaggeeffamu mormitoota irratti dhiibbaa fi gidiraa cimaa mootummaan geessisaa jiru keessatti. Dhimmi fayyaa pireezidaantichaa fi guddina biyyattii irratti gaaffiin guddaan waan jiruuf, jijjiirraa mootummaa yeroo dheeraaf eeggamaa turan irratti xiyyeeffannoon guddaan jira.

title: Israel’s Shin Bet finds no evidence of foreign election interference
english: Israel's internal security agency, the Shin Bet, has concluded that there was no involvement from foreign entities in the recent national elections. This investigation was launched following public debate and concerns regarding potential outside influence, particularly after Palestinian-Israeli political groups saw significant progress. The agency's findings have effectively dismissed claims that international actors attempted to manipulate the electoral process.
amharic: የእስራኤል የውስጥ ደህንነት ኤጀንሲ (ሺን ቤት) በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ሀገራዊ ምርጫ የውጭ ሀገራት ጣልቃ ገብነት እንደሌለ አረጋግጧል። ይህ ምርመራ የተካሄደው በተለይም የፍልስጤም-እስራኤል የፖለቲካ ቡድኖች ከፍተኛ ውጤት ካስመዘገቡ በኋላ በተነሱ ስጋቶች እና ውዝግቦች ሳቢያ ነበር። የደህንነት መስሪያ ቤቱ በምርጫ ሂደቱ ላይ የውጭ አካላት ተጽዕኖ ፈጥረዋል የሚባለውን ውንጀላ ውድቅ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Hojmaanni nageenyaa keessaa Israa'el, Shin Bet, filannoo biyyoolessaa darbe keessatti biyyoonni alaa harka akka hin qabanne mirkaneesseera. Qorannoon kun kan jalqabame, keessattuu gareewwan siyaasaa Falasxiin-Israa'el bu'aa guddaa argachuusaanii hordofee shakkii fi falmii uumamee ture. Ejansichi, qaamoleen alaa adeemsa filannichaa irratti dhiibbaa geessisaniiru jedhamee himatame hunda dhugaa akka hin qabne ibseera.

title: Poll finds Americans less likely to back pro-war candidates by 3-1 margin
english: A recent YouGov poll shows that Americans are significantly less likely to support political candidates who favor the ongoing war against Iran. Voters are prioritizing domestic economic concerns, such as rising prices, over the military objectives pursued by the Trump administration. Furthermore, a majority of citizens believe that Congress, rather than the president, should hold the final authority regarding the duration of the conflict.
amharic: የቅርብ ጊዜ የዩጎቭ (YouGov) የሕዝብ አስተያየት ጥናት እንደሚያሳየው አሜሪካውያን በኢራን ላይ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት የሚደግፉ እጩዎችን የመምረጥ ፍላጎታቸው በጣም ዝቅተኛ ነው። መራጮች በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከሚካሄዱ ወታደራዊ ግቦች ይልቅ የዋጋ ንረትን የመሳሰሉ የሀገር ውስጥ ኢኮኖሚያዊ ጉዳዮችን ያስቀድማሉ። በተጨማሪም አብዛኛው ህዝብ ጦርነቱ መቼ ማቆም እንዳለበት የመወሰን ስልጣን የፕሬዝዳንቱ ሳይሆን የኮንግረስ መሆን አለበት ብሎ ያምናል።
oromo: Qorannoon haaraan YouGov agarsiisutti, namoonni Ameerikaa hogganoota waraana Iraan irratti gaggeeffamaa jiru deggeran filachuuf fedhii akka hin qabne ibseera. Namoonni biyyattii waa'ee waraana kanaa irra caalaatti dhimma diinagdee fi daballii gatii gabaa irratti xiyyeeffachaa jiru. Akkasumas, namoonni hedduun waraanni kun yoom akka dhaabbatu murteessuun aangoo Kongiresii akka ta'e malee, aangoo pirezidaantii miti jedhanii amanu.

title: France blames Iran for October supermarket cyberattack
english: The French Foreign Minister has formally accused Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps of orchestrating a cyberattack last October. This digital assault targeted refrigeration systems across hundreds of supermarkets throughout France. Authorities identified the military organization as being responsible for the widespread technical disruption.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ባለፈው ጥቅምት ወር በፈረንሳይ የሱፐርማርኬት ማቀዝቀዣዎች ላይ ለተፈጸመው የሳይበር ጥቃት የኢራኑ እስላማዊ አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ኃላፊነቱን እንደሚወስድ በይፋ ከሰሱ። ጥቃቱ በመላ ሀገሪቱ በሚገኙ በመቶዎች በሚቆጠሩ መደብሮች ውስጥ በሚገኙ ማቀዝቀዣዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሷል። ባለስልጣናቱ ይህንን መጠነ ሰፊ የቴክኖሎጂ ረብሻ የፈጸመው የኢራን ወታደራዊ ክፍል መሆኑን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Faransaay, ji’a Onkololeessa darbe buufataalee gurgurtaa gurguddaa (supermarket) Faransaay keessatti rakkoo tekinooloojii uumameef humna tiksuu isaanii kan ta’e 'Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps' kan Iiraan akka himatan beekameera. Hojiin badii kun suuqota biyyattii keessatti argaman dhibbaan lakkaawaman keessatti firiijjiiwwan qabbaneessitoota irratti miidhaa geessiseera. Mootummaan Faransaay balaa kana qindeessee kan raawwate qaama waraana Iiraan ta’uu ibseera.

title: France accuses Iran of supermarket fridge hacking
english: The French government has officially accused Iran's Revolutionary Guard of orchestrating a large-scale cyberattack that disabled supermarket cooling systems, resulting in significant food waste. Foreign Minister Jean-Noël Barrot condemned the act as a serious threat to national security and confirmed that France will impose sanctions in response. While Iranian officials have dismissed these claims, French authorities have launched a formal investigation into a specific hacking unit linked to the Iranian military.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ መንግስት የአገሪቱን የሱፐርማርኬት ማቀዝቀዣዎች በመስመር ላይ ጥቃት በማበላሸት ከፍተኛ የምግብ ብክነት እንዲፈጠር ያደረገው የአራን አብዮታዊ ዘበኛ ቡድን ነው ሲል በይፋ ከሰሰ። የፈረንሳይ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ዣን-ኖኤል ባሮት ይህ ድርጊት ለብሄራዊ ደህንነት ከፍተኛ ስጋት መሆኑን ገልፀው ፈረንሳይ በአጥቂዎቹ ላይ ማዕቀብ እንደምትጥል አስታውቀዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት ክሱን ውድቅ ያደረጉ ቢሆንም የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት ከኢራን ወታደራዊ ክፍል ጋር ግንኙነት አለው በተባለው የሃከሮች ቡድን ላይ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Faransaay gareen waraana Iraan 'Revolutionary Guard' jedhamu, sirna qabbaneessituu (firiji) suuqiiwwan gurgurtaa Faransaay irratti qindeessee daa'ima koopputuu gurguddaa akkasumas nyaata hedduu mancaasuusaa himateera. Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Faransaay Jean-Noël Barrot, qaqqabbiin kun nageenya biyyaattiif soda guddaa ta'uu ibsuun, Faransaay tarkaanfii sanadaa irratti fudhachuuf akka jirtu beeksisaniiru. Mootummaan Iraan himannaa kana kan haale yoo ta'u, qorannoon Faransaay garuu garee haakeroota Iraan waliin hidhata qabu irratti eegalameera.

title: Nvidia shares tumble over investigation into Huang's affair with alleged Chinese spy
english: Nvidia’s stock value dropped significantly after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. While the company maintains that no trade secrets or national security interests were harmed, the board has launched an independent investigation into the matter. Furthermore, US lawmakers have requested that Huang attend a private briefing to discuss his personal ties and the firm's security measures against foreign espionage.
amharic: የኢንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው በማመናቸው የኩባንያው የአክሲዮን ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ቀንሷል። ኩባንያው ምንም አይነት ሚስጥራዊ መረጃ እንዳልተሰረቀ ቢገልጽም፣ የዳይሬክተሮች ቦርድ በአሁኑ ወቅት ጉዳዩን በገለልተኛ አካል እያጣራ ይገኛል። በተጨማሪም፣ የአሜሪካ የህግ አውጭዎች የኩባንያውን ደህንነትና የሁዋንግን የግል ግንኙነት ለመመርመር ከእሳቸው ጋር በሚስጥር ለመወያየት ቀጠሮ ይዘዋል።
oromo: Hoggansaan dhaabbata Nvidia, Jensen Huang, dubartii garee basaastota Chaayinaa keessaa ishee tokko jedhamtu waliin hariiroo fedhii foonii qabaachuu isaa erga amanee booda, gatiin aksiyoona dhaabbatichaa gadi bu'eera. Dhaabbatichi waa'ee iccitii teeknooloojii ykn nageenya biyyaalessaa irratti miidhaan tokko illee akka hin geenyee ibsuus, boordiin qajeelchaa qorannoo bilisa ta'e jalqabeera. Kana malees, abbootiin seeraa Ameerikaa hariiroo dhuunfaa hogganaa kanaa fi eegumsa teeknooloojii dhaabbatichaa irratti ibsa kennuuf akka dhiyaatu waamicha taasisaniiru.

title: Trump questions midterm elections integrity after previously accepting results
english: President Donald Trump has raised doubts about the integrity of the midterm election results despite previously stating he would accept the outcome. Although Democrats won majorities in both houses of Congress following a performance that aligned with pre-election polls, Trump claimed without evidence that the voting process was dishonest. Experts and election officials maintain that the election was conducted smoothly and that the vote-counting process followed standard procedures.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ከዚህ ቀደም የምርጫውን ውጤት እንደሚቀበሉ ቢናገሩም፣ አሁን ግን በመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ውጤት ታማኝነት ላይ ጥርጣሬያቸውን ገልጸዋል። ዲሞክራቶች በሁለቱም የምክር ቤት ክፍሎች አብላጫ ድምፅ ቢያገኙም፣ ትራምፕ ምንም አይነት ማስረጃ ሳያቀርቡ ምርጫው ታማኝ እንዳልነበር በመግለጽ ውንጀላ ሰንዝረዋል። የምርጫ ባለሙያዎች እና የሀገር ውስጥ ባለስልጣናት ግን ምርጫው በሰላም እና በተለመደው የሂደት አሰራር መሰረት መጠናቀቁን አረጋግጠዋል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolnaald Traamp kanaan dura bu'aa filannichaa akka fudhatan ibsuun isaanii kan yaadatamu ta'us, amma garuu amanamummaa filannoo giddu-galeessaa irratti shakki qaban ibsaniiru. Paartiin Diimokraatotaa mana maree lamaan keessattuu injifannoo argachuu isaanii fi kunis yaada uummataa dursanii qoratamanii turan waliin kan deemu ta'us, Traamp ragaa tokko malee filannichi haqaan akka hin geggeeffamne dubbataniiru. Hayyoonni fi ogeeyyoonni filannoo gama isaaniin, filannichi sirnaan fi karaa nagaa ta'een geggeeffamuu isaa fi hujiin lakkoofsa sagalee sirnaan raawwatamuu isaa mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Turkey steel factory blast kills at least 17 people
english: A major explosion at the Habas iron and steel plant in Turkey's Izmir province has left 17 workers dead and 12 others injured. The accident occurred during routine maintenance when a crane collapsed, causing equipment to fall into a furnace. Authorities are currently conducting investigations into the incident, and five individuals have already been taken into custody.
amharic: በቱርክ ኢዝሚር ግዛት በሚገኘው የሀባስ ብረት እና ብረት ፋብሪካ በተከሰተ ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታ 17 ሠራተኞች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 12 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። አደጋው የደረሰው መደበኛ የጥገና ሥራ እየተከናወነ ባለበት ወቅት ክሬን በመውደቁ ምክንያት ቁሳቁሶች ምድጃ ውስጥ በመግባታቸው ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ሲሆን፣ እስከ አሁን ድረስ አምስት ሰዎች በቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Turkiitti, godina Izmiritti, warshaa sibiilaa Habas jedhamu keessatti balaa dhohuu mudateen hojjettoonni 17 du'anii 12 immoo madaa'aniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo suphaa idilee geggeeffamaa turetti maashiniin (crane) kufee meeshaaleen ibidda keessa seenuudhaan dha. Aangeyyoonni balaa kana irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiran yoo ta'u, namoonni shan ammoo to'annaa jala oolaniiru.

title: Republican congressman to force impeachment vote on Defence Secretary Hegseth
english: Republican Congressman Thomas Massie is forcing a vote to impeach Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of illegally conducting military operations in Iran without legislative approval. While the move is unlikely to succeed, Massie argues it is necessary to hold the Secretary accountable and encourages President Trump to appoint a replacement before Democrats take control of Congress. Hegseth has dismissed the threat, stating he is not concerned about the impeachment efforts.
amharic: የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲው የኮንግረስ አባል ቶማስ ማሲ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በህገ-ወጥ መንገድ ኢራን ውስጥ ወታደራዊ እርምጃ ወስደዋል በሚል ክስ በስልጣን እንዲነሱ ለማድረግ እየሞከሩ ነው። ይህ ሙከራ ስኬታማ የመሆን እድሉ ዝቅተኛ ቢሆንም፣ ማሲ ሚኒስትሩ ተጠያቂ መሆን አለባቸው በማለት ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ ዲሞክራቶች ስልጣን ከመረከባቸው በፊት ተተኪ እንዲሾሙ ይገፋፋሉ። ሚኒስትር ሄግሴት በበኩላቸው ክሱን እንደማይጨነቁበት ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Miseensi Kongirasii paartii Rippabilikanii Tomaas Maasii, Ministirri Ittisaa Piit Heegseth hayyama seeraan ala gara biyya Iraan duula waraanaa gaggeessaniiru jechuun, aangoo irraa akka ka'an gochuuf sagalee akka kennamuuf dirqisiisaa jiru. Yaaliin kun milkaa'uun isaa kan hin oolle ta'us, Maasii tarkaanfiin kun Ministirichi itti gaafatama akka fudhatan taasisa fi Pirezidaant Traamp ammoo gareen Demokiraatotaa aangoo fudhachuu isaanii dura bakka bu'aa biraa akka ramadan gorsu jedhu. Heegseth gama isaaniitiin, yaalii kana baay'isee akka hin yaaddofne ibsaniiru.

title: Deadly explosion at Iron and steel plant in Turkiye
english: A major explosion at an iron and steel factory in the Izmir province of Turkey has resulted in the deaths of at least 16 employees. President Recep Tayyip Erdogan confirmed the tragedy, while noting that 13 other workers sustained injuries. Emergency teams are currently conducting search and rescue efforts, as it is believed that additional people may still be buried beneath the wreckage.
amharic: በቱርክ ኢዝሚር ግዛት በሚገኝ የብረት ፋብሪካ ውስጥ በተከሰተ ከባድ ፍንዳታ ቢያንስ 16 ሠራተኞች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። የቱርክ ፕሬዝዳንት ረሲፕ ጣይብ ኤርዶጋን እንደገለጹት፣ ሌሎች 13 ሠራተኞችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በፍርስራሹ ስር ተጠምደው የሚገኙ ሠራተኞች ሊኖሩ እንደሚችሉ በመሰጋቱ የነፍስ አድን ስራው አሁንም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Turkiitti naannoo Izmiritti qorqoorroo fi sibiila oomishuun kan beekamu warshaa tokko keessatti dhohiinsa guddaa uumameen hojjettoonni 16 ol ta'an du'aniiru. Pireezidaantiin Turki Recep Tayyip Erdogan akka mirkaneessanitti, namoonni 13 immoo miidhaan irra ga'ee jira. Hojjettoonni biroo diigama warshichaa jalatti hafuu danda'u waan shakkameef, hojiin barbaacha fi lubbuu oolchuu ammayyuu itti fufee jira.

title: Russell Brand sentenced to 10.5 years over sexual assault charges
english: Russell Brand has received a prison sentence of ten and a half years following his conviction for multiple sexual offenses. The court found him guilty of raping one woman and assaulting three others between 2004 and 2009. The presiding judge criticized Brand for exploiting his fame to abuse his victims.
amharic: ረሰል ብራንድ በፈጸማቸው ተከታታይ የጾታ ጥቃት ወንጀሎች የ10 ዓመት ከስድስት ወር እስራት ተፈርዶበታል። በ2004 እና በ2009 መካከል በአንድ ሴት ላይ አስገድዶ መድፈር እና በሌሎች ሶስት ሴቶች ላይ ደግሞ የጾታ ጥቃት መፈጸሙ ተረጋግጧል። ዳኛው ተዋናዩ ዝናውን በመጠቀም ሴቶችን ሲበድል እንደነበር በመግለጽ ድርጊቱን አውግዘዋል።
oromo: Raassel Biraandi yakka saalaa raawwateen waggaa kudhanii fi ji'a ja'aaf hidhutti murameera. Biraandi bara 2004 fi 2009 gidduutti dubartii tokko irratti gudeeddii fi dubartoota biroo sadii irratti yakka saalaa raawwachuun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Manni murtichaa beekamtii isaa fayyadamuun dubartoota miidhuu isaa balaaleffateera.

title: Explosion at Turkish steel plant kills at least 16 people
english: A tragic explosion at the HABAS steel plant in Aliaga, Turkey, has resulted in the deaths of at least 16 people and left 13 others injured. The incident occurred when an overhead crane collapsed into an industrial furnace during maintenance work, prompting President Erdogan to order a formal investigation. The facility has faced ongoing criticism from workers' groups regarding poor safety standards and a history of fatal accidents.
amharic: በቱርክ አሊያጋ በሚገኘው የሃባስ ብረታ ብረት ፋብሪካ በደረሰ አሳዛኝ የፍንዳታ አደጋ ቢያንስ 16 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ 13 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። አደጋው የተከሰተው ጥገና በሚደረግበት ወቅት አንድ ግዙፍ ክሬን ወደ እቶን ምድጃ ውስጥ በመውደቁ ነው። ፕሬዝዳንት ኤርዶغان በጉዳዩ ላይ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ ያዘዙ ሲሆን፣ ፋብሪካው ለረጅም ጊዜ የደህንነት ችግሮች እንዳሉበት የሰራተኞች ቡድኖች በመግለጽ ላይ ናቸው።
oromo: Turkiitti bakka warshaa sibiilaa HABAS jedhamuutti balaa dhohiinsa mudateen lubbuun namoota 16 darbee, namoonni 13 immoo miidhamaniiru. Balaan kun kan uumame yeroo hojiin suphaa adeemaa jirutti kireeniin guddaan tokko gara iddoo abiddaatti kufuun isaatiin dha. Pireezidaanti Erdogaan balaa kana irratti qorannoon akka gaggeeffamu ajajeera; gareewwan hojjettootaas warshaan kun hanqina nageenyaa akka qabu fi balaan walitti aansuun akka isatti mudatu ibsaniiru.

title: South Africa detains foreigners suspected of heading to join Russian forces
english: South African police have arrested nine foreign nationals at Johannesburg's airport who were allegedly planning to join the Russian military for the war in Ukraine. Authorities suspect these individuals were targeted by recruitment schemes that often lure foreign citizens with false promises of civilian jobs. The detainees now face charges under South African laws that prohibit mercenary activities and unauthorized foreign military participation.
amharic: የደቡብ አፍሪካ ፖሊስ በጆሃንስበርግ አየር ማረፊያ በዩክሬን ጦርነት ውስጥ በሩሲያ በኩል ለመሰለፍ ሲዘጋጁ የነበሩ ዘጠኝ የውጭ ሀገር ዜጎችን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። እነዚህ ግለሰቦች በሲቪል ስራ ሰበብ የተታለሉ እና ለጦርነት እንዲሰለፉ የተገደዱ ሊሆኑ እንደሚችሉ ተጠቅሷል። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ በደቡብ አፍሪካ ህግ መሰረት በቅጥረኛ ወታደርነት እና በህገ-ወጥ የውጭ ሀገር ወታደራዊ እንቅስቃሴ ክስ ሊመሰረትባቸው ነው።
oromo: Poolisiin Afrikaa Kibbaa namoota biyya alaa sagal ta'an, waraana Yukreen irratti Ruusiyaaf gargaaruuf gara biyyattii imaluu yaalaa turan buufata xiyyaaraa Joohannisbargitti qabateera. Namoonni kunneen hojii nagaa arganna jedhanii gowwoomfamanii gara waraanaatti kan bobbaafaman ta'uu shakkuun, seera biyyattii kan yakka raayyaa ittisa biyya alaa irratti hirmaachuu dhorguun himatamuuf jiru.

title: How is Gaza coping with another severe winter?
english: Gaza is currently facing a harsh winter season that has severely impacted displaced Palestinians. A recent major storm flooded over 70,000 tents in just half a day, leaving many families without adequate shelter. Due to ongoing Israeli restrictions, residents are struggling to repair their damaged homes and survive the freezing conditions.
amharic: ጋዛ በአሁኑ ወቅት የተፈናቀሉ ፍልስጤማውያንን በእጅጉ የጎዳ ከባድ የክረምት ወራት እያስተናገደች ትገኛለች። በቅርቡ በተከሰተው ከባድ አውሎ ንፋስ በግማሽ ቀን ውስጥ ብቻ ከ70,000 በላይ ድንኳኖች በጎርፍ ተጥለቅልቀዋል፣ ይህም ብዙ ቤተሰቦችን መጠለያ አልባ አድርጓቸዋል። በእስራኤል በተጣሉ ገደቦች ሳቢያ ነዋሪዎቹ የተጎዱ መጠለያዎቻቸውን ለመጠገን እና ከብርድ ለመትረፍ ከፍተኛ ችግር ውስጥ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Gaazzan yeroo ammaa kana ji'oota ganna cimaa kan ummata Falasxiin buqqa'anii jiran miidhaa jiru keessa dabartooti jira. Obomboleettiin cimaa dhiheenya kana ture sa'aatii muraasa keessatti dunkaana 70,000 ol kan liqimse yoo ta'u, maatiiwwan hedduu mana jireenyaa malee hambiseera. Daangaa Israa'el keesseen kan ka'e, namoonni miidhamaniif gargaarsa argachuu fi qoricha ganna kanaa ofirraa ittisuuf rakkoo guddaa keessa jiru.

title: Krakow shooting suspect has died in hospital, police say
english: A 24-year-old Polish man suspected of killing nine people, including his own family members and victims in Krakow’s city center, has died in the hospital. The attacker, who reportedly held far-right extremist views, was shot by police shortly after the assault began. Authorities confirmed that the victims in the city square included both Polish citizens and foreign nationals.
amharic: በፖላንድ ክራኮው ከተማ ዘጠኝ ሰዎችን የገደለው የ24 ዓመት ወጣት በሆስፒታል ህክምና ላይ እያለ መሞቱን ፖሊስ አስታውቋል። ጥቃቱን የፈጸመው ግለሰብ የጽንፈኛ ቀኝ አክራሪ አስተሳሰብ ተከታይ እንደነበር የተገለጸ ሲሆን፣ በፖሊስ ተኩስ ተመትቶ ነበር። በከተማዋ መሃል በተፈጸመው በዚህ ድርጊት የፖላንድ ዜጎችን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ አገራት ዜጎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል።
oromo: Namni umriin isaa waggaa 24 fi lammii Poolaand ta'e, namoota sagal ajjeese jedhamee shakkamu, hospitaala keessatti lubbuun isaa darbeera. Namni kun yaada faashistummaa fi mirga-duraa hordofaa akka ture kan ibsame yoo ta'u, erga haleellaa kana raawwatee daqiiqaa muraasa keessatti poolisootaan dhukaasni itti banamee akka madaaye ni beekama. Haleellaa kana keessatti lammiileen Poolaandii fi biyyoota garaa garaa irraa dhufan ajjeefamaniiru.

title: Inside the French drug gangs recruiting children to kill
english: Drug gangs in Marseille, France, are increasingly exploiting vulnerable teenagers by recruiting them for illegal activities under the guise of work. These young people often face brutal violence, sexual abuse, and blackmail if they fail to meet gang demands. This situation highlights a dangerous cycle of exploitation where gangs use fear and social media to trap youth in organized crime.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ማርሴይ ከተማ የሚገኙ የአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ቡድኖች ተጋላጭ የሆኑ ታዳጊዎችን በስራ ሽፋን ወደ ህገ-ወጥ ድርጊቶች እየመለመሉ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ታዳጊዎች የቡድኑን ትዕዛዝ ካልፈፀሙ ከፍተኛ አካላዊ ድብደባ፣ የጾታዊ ጥቃት እና ማስፈራሪያ ይደርስባቸዋል። ይህ አስከፊ ሁኔታ የወንጀል ቡድኖች በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በመጠቀም ወጣቶችን ወደ ወንጀል ዓለም እንደሚጎትቱ የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Gareewwan daldala qoricha sammuu nama hadoochan kan magaalaa Maarsii Faransaay, dargaggoota rakkoo keessa jiran hojii dha jedhanii sobuun gara yakkaatti bobbaasaa jiru. Dargaggoonni kunniin yoo ajaja garee kanaa raawwachuu dadhaban, dararaa qaamaa, miidhaa saalaa fi doorsisaaf saaxilamu. Haalli kun gareewwan yakkaa kun interneetii fayyadamanii dargaggoota akkamitti akka gara yakkaatti harkisan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump says he was 'kidding' about Dana White press secretary offer
english: President Donald Trump has clarified that his recent offer for UFC CEO Dana White to become the White House press secretary was merely a joke. Although Trump had publicly claimed on social media that he invited White to the role, he later told reporters that the comment was not meant to be taken seriously. White, who leads multiple business ventures, is still scheduled to meet with the president, though not to discuss taking the government position.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የዩኤፍሲ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ዳና ዋይትን የዋይት ሃውስ ፕሬስ ፀሐፊ እንዲሆኑ ያቀረቡት ጥያቄ ቀልድ እንደነበር ገልጸዋል። ትራምፕ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ በኩል ስራውን እንደሰጡ ቢናገሩም፣ በኋላ ላይ ግን ይህ አስተያየት ከባድ እንዳልነበር ለጋዜጠኞች ተናግረዋል። ዳና ዋይት ከፕሬዝዳንቱ ጋር በቅርቡ ለመገናኘት ቀጠሮ ቢኖራቸውም፣ ውይይታቸው ግን ይህንን የመንግስት ስልጣን ለመረከብ አይደለም።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doonald Traamp qondaalli UFC Daanaa Waayit akka dubbi himaa Waayit Haaws ta'an ibsanii turan sun tapha ykn qoosaa qofa akka ture ibsaniiru. Traamp miidiyaa hawaasummaa irratti waamicha kana erguun isaanii kan yaadatamu ta'us, boodarra garuu dubbichi qoosadhaa jechuun ibsaniiru. Daanaa Waayit gara fuulduratti pireezidaanticha waliin kan wal argu ta'us, dhimmi kun gara bakka bu'ummaa mootummaatti dhufuuf miti.

title: At least 34 dead after Europe-bound migrant boat sinks off Senegal
english: A wooden boat carrying migrants toward Spain's Canary Islands capsized off the coast of Senegal, resulting in at least 34 deaths. While one survivor has been rescued, search efforts are ongoing to determine if others remain missing. In response, Senegal's President has promised to crack down on human trafficking networks and encouraged citizens to avoid these perilous sea journeys.
amharic: ወደ ስፔን ካናሪ ደሴቶች ሲጓዝ የነበረ ስደተኞችን የያዘ ጀልባ በሴኔጋል የባህር ዳርቻ ላይ በመስጠሙ ቢያንስ 34 ሰዎች ሞተዋል። በአደጋው አንድ ሰው በሕይወት የተረፈ ሲሆን፣ የጠፉ ሰዎችን የመፈለግ ስራው ቀጥሏል። የሴኔጋል ፕሬዝዳንት በአደጋው የተሰማቸውን ጥልቅ ሀዘን በመግለጽ፣ ህገ-ወጥ የሰዎች አዘዋዋሪዎችን ለመቆጣጠር እና ወጣቶች ህይወታቸውን ለአደጋ የሚያጋልጥ ጉዞ እንዳያደርጉ ለመከላከል እንደሚሰሩ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Dooniin baqattoota gara odoolota Ispeen Kaanaarii geessuuf imalaa turte qarqara Senegaalitti gombifamuu isheen namoonni 34 ol du'aniiru. Namni tokko lubbuun kan fayye yoo ta'u, barbaacha namoota biroo itti fufuun isaa ibsameera. Preezidaantiin Senegaal balaa kanaan gaddi itti dhaga'ame ibsuun, namoota seeraan alaa baqattoota deddeebisan irratti tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhatan fi lammiileen isaanii imala balaa qabu kana irraa akka of qusatan dhaamaniiru.

title: Pope delivers veiled rebuke of Milei's austerity measures
english: Pope Leo XIV visited Argentina and voiced concerns regarding President Javier Milei's strict austerity policies. The Pope emphasized that economic systems should prioritize the welfare of vulnerable citizens, specifically highlighting the impact of spending cuts on those with disabilities. Additionally, the pontiff encouraged political leaders to practice more respectful communication and to manage their authority with greater caution.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ አሥራ አራተኛ አርጀንቲናን በጎበኙበት ወቅት በፕሬዚዳንት ጃቪየር ሚሌይ የኢኮኖሚ ማሻሻያ ፖሊሲዎች ላይ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል። ሊቀ ጳጳሳቱ የሀገሪቱ ኢኮኖሚ ለድሆች እና ለተጎዱ ወገኖች ትኩረት መስጠት እንዳለበት በመግለጽ፣ በመንግስት የተደረገው የበጀት ቅነሳ በልዩ ፍላጎት ላይ ያሉ ዜጎችን መጉዳቱን ጠቁመዋል። እንዲሁም መሪዎች በንግግራቸው ረገድ ጥንቃቄ እንዲያደርጉና በስልጣናቸው ሲጠቀሙ ለህዝብ ጥቅም ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጡ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Pappaan Leo XIV gara Arjantinii imalanitti yaada isaanii kan ibsan yoo ta'u, imaammata dinagdee cimaa kan pirezidaant Jaaviyeer Miileey irratti komii qaban himaniiru. Pappaan kun akka jedhanitti, dinagdeen biyyattii keessattuu namoota harka qalleeyyii fi qaama miidhamtootaaf kan dirmachuu qabu malee, akkaataa itti baajanni hir'ifame kun isaan irratti dhiibbaa geessiseera. Kana malees, hoogganoonni biyyattii afaan isaanii eeggachuu fi aangoonsaanii faayidaa uummata hundumaatiif akka oolu gorsa kennaniiru.

title: At least one person killed as Russia and Ukraine trade strikes overnight
english: A recent exchange of overnight drone and missile attacks between Russia and Ukraine resulted in at least one civilian death and significant damage to a major Russian oil refinery. In response to ongoing Russian strikes on power grids, Ukraine is establishing a new emergency funding agreement with the European Union to repair essential energy infrastructure. Meanwhile, Russia continues to target Ukrainian utility systems and claims to have intercepted over a hundred drones while hitting a ship it accuses of transporting weapons.
amharic: በቅርቡ በሩሲያ እና በዩክሬን መካከል በተደረገው የሌሊት ድሮን እና ሚሳይል ጥቃት ቢያንስ አንድ ሰው መሞቱ እና በሩሲያ ዋና የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት መድረሱ ተነግሯል። ሩሲያ በዩክሬን የኃይል ማመንጫዎች ላይ የምታደርሰውን ጥቃት ተከትሎ፣ ዩክሬን የተጎዱ መሰረተ ልማቶችን በፍጥነት ለመጠገን ከአውሮፓ ህብረት ጋር የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ስምምነት አድርጋለች። በሌላ በኩል ሩሲያ በዩክሬን የኤሌክትሪክ አውታሮች ላይ ጥቃት ማድረሷን የቀጠለች ሲሆን፣ ከ100 በላይ የዩክሬን ድሮኖችን መትታ መጣሏን እና የጦር መሳሪያ ይዟል ያለችውን መርከብ ማጥቃቷን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Halkan darbetti weerara rooroo fi xiyyaaraan biyyoota lamaan gidduutti gaggeeffameen namni tokko yoo du'u, qabeenyi qilleensa isaa irratti miidhaan guddaan gahee jira. Hojiin raashiyaan buufataalee anniisaa Yukreen irratti gaggeessitu akkayya ta'uun, Yukreen miidhaa irra gahe battalaan suphuuf gargaarsa maallaqaa gamtaa Awurooppaa waliin walii galtee uumtee jirti. Gamtaan gama biraatiin, Raashiyaan buufataalee anniisaa Yukreen rukutuushee itti fuftee kan jirtu yoo ta'u, rooroo Yukreen 100 ol ta'an akka garagalchite fi markaba meeshaa waraanaa fe'e jedhamu irratti haleellaa raawwachuushee ibsiteetti.

title: Iran’s authorities harden domestic security controls amid US strike threats
english: In response to ongoing tensions and potential military threats from the United States, Iranian authorities have significantly tightened domestic security. The government is strictly enforcing public conduct rules and threatening severe penalties against any form of dissent or protests. Furthermore, officials are actively mobilizing loyalist supporters while using harsh judicial measures, including executions, to suppress internal opposition they label as foreign-backed terrorism.
amharic: ከአሜሪካ ጋር በተፈጠረው የጦር ግጭት እና በስጋት ምክንያት የኢራን መንግስት የውስጥ ደህንነት ቁጥጥሩን አጥብቋል። ባለስልጣናት በህዝብ ቦታዎች ላይ የሚደረገውን እንቅስቃሴ በጥብቅ እየተቆጣጠሩ ሲሆን፣ መንግስትን የሚቃወም ማንኛውም ተቃውሞ ከባድ ቅጣት እንደሚጠብቀው አስጠንቅቀዋል። በተጨማሪም መንግስት የራሱን ደጋፊዎች በማሰባሰብ እና ተቃዋሚዎችን በሀገር ክህደት በመክሰስ ከባድ የእስር እና የሞት ቅጣቶችን እየፈፀመ ይገኛል።

title: The DNA that Unmasked a Killer | True Crime Reports
english: For over two decades, the murder of Leslie Preer remained an unsolved cold case despite early suspicions toward her husband. Recently, advanced genetic testing allowed investigators to identify a different person as the prime suspect, who was living very far from the crime scene. Police were then able to successfully lure and capture the individual, finally bringing resolution to the long-standing mystery.
amharic: የሌስሊ ፕሪር ግድያ ለ21 ዓመታት ሳይፈታ የቆየ ቢሆንም፣ ቀደም ሲል ባለቤቷ ላይ ጥርጣሬ ቢኖርም መፍትሄ አላገኘም ነበር። በቅርቡ በተደረገ ዘመናዊ የዲኤንኤ ምርመራ አማካኝነት ተጠርጣሪው ሌላ ሰው መሆኑ ተለይቶ ታወቀ። ፖሊስም ከወንጀሉ ቦታ እጅግ የራቀ አካባቢ ይኖር የነበረውን ይህንን ተጠርጣሪ ወጥመድ በመዘርጋት በቁጥጥር ስር ማዋል ችሏል።
oromo: Ajjeechaan Leslie Preer waggoota 21f utuu hin furamin kan ture yoo ta'u, erga husbandii ishii irratti shakkiin ture booda dhimmi kun gadi fagatee ture. Yeroo ammaa kana garuu teeknooloojii DNA ammayyaatti fayyadamuudhaan qorattoonni namni ajjeechaa kana raawwate kan biraa ta'uu isaa fi bakka yakkichi itti raawwatame irraa fagaatee jiraachuu isaa hubachuu danda'aniiru. Poolisiin kiyyoo diriirsuudhaan shakkamicha to'annoo jala oolchuu danda'eera.

title: Qatar PM to meet Trump: What’s the latest on US-Iran negotiations?
english: Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani is traveling to Washington to meet with President Donald Trump and Vice President JD Vance regarding the ongoing conflict with Iran. Qatar is currently acting as a mediator as the US reviews a new proposal from Tehran aimed at resolving nuclear program disputes and ceasefire terms. While Iran has threatened severe retaliation if US military strikes resume, both sides are engaged in high-level discussions to manage these tensions.
amharic: የኳታር ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ መሐመድ ቢን አብዱልራህማን ቢን ጃሲም አል ታኒ ከአሜሪካ ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ እና ምክትል ፕሬዚዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ጋር ለመወያየት ወደ ዋሽንግተን እያቀኑ ነው። ኳታር በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል እንደ አደራዳሪነት እየሰራች ሲሆን፣ ዋሽንግተንም ከቴህራን የቀረበውን አዲስ የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም እና የተኩስ አቁም የሰላም ዕቅድ እየመረመረች ነው። ምንም እንኳን ኢራን የአሜሪካ ጥቃት እንደገና ከተጀመረ ጠንካራ አጸፋ እንደምትወስድ ብታስጠነቅቅም፣ ውጥረቱን ለመቀነስ ከፍተኛ የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮች እየተካሄዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Mummichi Ministeera Qatar Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani dhimma waldhabdee Iran waliin jiru irratti mari'achuuf gara Washington imaluuf qophaa'aniiru. Qatar giddu-galeessummaa kan taate yoo ta'u, gama tokkoon mootummaan Ameerikaa dhiyeessa haarawaa Iran irraa dhufe kan sagantaa niwukilaraa fi dhaabbii waraanaa irratti xiyyeeffatu qorachaa jira. Iran yoo weerarri Ameerikaa itti fufe tarkaanfii cimaa akka fudhattu akeekkachiisteeyyuu, gama lamaaniin rakkoo kana furuuf mariin dippiloomaasii cimaan adeemsifamaa jira.

title: Trump says his immigration policy ‘too tough’ for voters
english: President Donald Trump acknowledged that his aggressive deportation policies likely hurt the Republican Party in the recent midterm elections. While admitting his approach may have been overly harsh, he expressed a willingness to negotiate a more moderate immigration deal with the newly elected Democratic Congress. Despite these comments, his decision to appoint Stephen Miller, a key architect of his hardline policies, as his new chief of staff has sparked skepticism about whether a real policy shift will occur.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ጠንካራ የስደት መቆጣጠሪያ ፖሊሲያቸው በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የመካከለኛው ዘመን ምርጫ ለሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ሽንፈት ምክንያት እንደሆነ አምነዋል። የወሰዱት እርምጃ ከመጠን በላይ ጥብቅ እንደነበረ ቢገልጹም፣ በአዲሱ የዲሞክራቶች ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው ኮንግረስ አማካኝነት ይበልጥ መካከለኛ የሆነ የስደት ስምምነት ለመፍጠር ፍላጎት እንዳላቸው ተናግረዋል። ሆኖም፣ ጥብቅ የፖሊሲ አቀንቃኙን እስጢፋኖስ ሚለርን የኋይት ሀውስ ዋና አዛዥ አድርገው መሾማቸው፣ በእርግጥ የፖሊሲ ለውጥ ይመጣ ይሆን የሚል ጥርጣሬ ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Doolaard Tiraamp imaayigreeshinii irratti tarkaanfiin inni cimaan fudhate filannoo gidduu waggaa darbe keessatti paartii Ripabliikaanirratti dhiibbaa geessiseera jedhanii amanan. Ilaalchi isaanii kun hamma tokko cimaa akka ture kan dubbatan yoo ta'u, kongeerasii harka Diimookraatonni jiru waliin ta'uun imaayigreeshinii irratti waliigaltee madaalawaa ta'e uumuuf fedhii qabaachuu ibsaniiru. Ta'us, namicha imaayigreeshinii irratti imaammata cimaa baasaa ture Stiiven Miilar jedhaman gara aangootti fiduun isaanii, jijjiiramni imaammataa dhugaan ni dhufa jedhee shakkiin akka uumamu godheera.

title: Iran defends two-day proposal for peace talks after US rejects conditions
english: Iran has defended its proposal to resume peace talks within two days, arguing that its demands for the removal of US sanctions and a naval blockade are necessary preconditions. While US officials have dismissed these requirements as unacceptable, Iran maintains that stopping the war and easing restrictions are logical steps toward diplomacy. Additionally, Iran criticized recent American efforts to pressure Iraq into closing borders, labeling such military initiatives as political distractions.
amharic: ኢራን የሰላም ንግግሮችን በአጭር ጊዜ ውስጥ ለመጀመር ያቀረበችውን ሃሳብ በመከላከል፣ የአሜሪካ ማዕቀቦች እና የባህር ላይ እገዳዎች መነሳት አለባቸው የሚለውን ቅድመ ሁኔታ እንደ አስፈላጊ እርምጃ ገልጻለች። የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት እነዚህን ጥያቄዎች ውድቅ ቢያደርጉም፣ ኢራን ጦርነቱን ማቆም ለዲፕሎማሲው መፍትሄ ወሳኝ መሆኑን ትከራከራለች። በተጨማሪም ኢራን አሜሪካ በኢራቅ ላይ ድንበር እንዲዘጋ የምታደርገውን ጫና በመቃወም፣ ይህም የፖለቲካ ትኩረትን ለመቀየር የሚደረግ ሙከራ መሆኑን ገልጻለች።
oromo: Iraan marii nagaa guyyoota lama keessatti jalqabuuf yaada dhiyeessiteetti, kunis tarkanfii barbaachisaa ta'uu ibsiteetti. Iraan mariin kun akka jalqabuuf akkaataa sanadaa fi daangaa galaana irraa ka'uu qaba jettee gaafatteetti, haa ta'u malee mootummaan Ameerikaa gaaffii kana fudhatama kan hin qabne jedhee komateera. Dabalataanis, Iraan Ameerikaan Iraaq daangaa ishee akka cufu dhiibbaa gochuun ishee jeeqama siyaasaa uumuuf kan karoorfame ta'uu isaa ibsiteetti.

title: Gaza: Five Palestinians killed as sand embankment collapses on displacement tents
english: In Deir al-Balah, Gaza, five people including three children and two women died when a sand embankment collapsed onto their tents during heavy storms. Rescue teams are continuing search efforts as many others remain injured following the incident. Authorities attribute the tragedy to the lack of proper shelter and infrastructure caused by the ongoing war and blockade.
amharic: በጋዛ ዲር አል-በላህ አካባቢ በደረሰ ከባድ የዝናብ እና የነፋስ አውሎ ነፋስ ምክንያት የአሸዋ ክምር በመውደቁ ሶስት ህጻናትን እና ሁለት ሴቶችን ጨምሮ አምስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። በአደጋው የቆሰሉ ሌሎች ሰዎች በነፍስ አድን ሰራተኞች ታድገው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ሲሆን፣ የፍለጋ ስራውም ቀጥሏል። የሰብአዊ መብት ድርጅቶች እና ባለስልጣናት ይህ አደጋ የደረሰው በጦርነቱ ምክንያት በተፈጠረው የቤት እጦት እና የሰብአዊ እርዳታ እጥረት መሆኑን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Gaza keessatti iddoo Deir al-Balah jedhamutti rooba cimaa fi bubbee hordofee gaarreen cirrachaa dunkaana buqqaatonni keessa jiraatan irratti kufuun ijoollee sadii fi dubartoota lama dabalatee namoonni shan lubbuun darbaniiru. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa namoota miidhaman baasuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiran yoo ta'u, rakkoon kun kan dhufe waraanaa fi daangaa cufamee jiruun walqabatee iddoon jireenyaa mijataa dhabamuu isaatiin akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Trump says he thinks he will meet with Xi, Putin, set to discuss ending war on Iran
english: President Donald Trump expects to hold meetings with the leaders of China and Russia during the upcoming APEC summit in Shenzhen. During these discussions, he intends to address various global topics, including the goal of nuclear disarmament. Furthermore, the President highlighted his administration's ongoing efforts to conclude the conflict in Iran through economic pressure.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በቅርቡ በሼንዘን በሚካሄደው የኤፒክ (APEC) ጉባኤ ላይ ከቻይና እና ከሩሲያ መሪዎች ጋር ለመገናኘት እንደሚጠብቁ ገልጸዋል። በእነዚህ ውይይቶች ወቅት ስለ የኑክሌር መርሃ ግብሮች እና ሌሎች ዓለም አቀፍ ጉዳዮች ላይ ለመነጋገር አቅደዋል። በተጨማሪም ፕሬዝዳንቱ የኢኮኖሚ ማዕቀቦችን በመጠቀም በኢራን እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት ለማቆም ጥረት እያደረጉ መሆናቸውን ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantichi Donald Traamp torban dhufu magaalaa Sheenzeenitti walga'ii APEC irratti geggeeffamu irratti hogganoota Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaa waliin wal arguuf akka karoorfatan ibsaniiru. Marii isaanii kanaanis dhimmoota addunyaa fi dhimma diinagdee niwukileerii irratti kan mari'atan ta'a. Dabalataanis, pirezidaantichi dhiibbaa diinagdee fayyadamuun waraana Iraan keessatti adeemaa jiru xumursiisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiran ibsaniiru.

title: China says it is willing to promote fresh progress in bilateral relations with Iran
english: China's Middle East envoy, Zhai Jun, recently visited Iran to discuss strengthening ties between the two nations. During his meetings, he emphasized that the current regional conflicts cannot be solved through military means. Both sides expressed a desire to advance their bilateral relationship further.
amharic: የቻይና የመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ልዩ መልዕክተኛ ዣይ ጁን በኢራን ያደረጉት ጉብኝት በሁለቱ አገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት ለማጠናከር ያለመ ነው። በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያለው ቀውስ በወታደራዊ ኃይል ሊፈታ እንደማይችል የገለጹት መልዕክተኛው፣ የሁለቱን ወገኖች የትብብር ግንኙነት ለማሳደግ ያላቸውን ፍላጎት አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Ergamoonni Chaayinaa kan gidduu galeessa bahaa Zhaay Juun biyya Iraan daawwataniiru. Ergamoonni kun hariiroo biyyoota lamaan gidduu jiru cimsuuf mari'ataniiru. Rakkoon gidduu galeessa bahaa humna waraanaan furamuu akka hin dandeenye ibsuun, hariiroo isaan cimsuuf fedhii qaban beeksisaniiru.

title: Trump set to meet Qatar’s prime minister at the White House
english: President Donald Trump is scheduled to host a private meeting with the Prime Minister of Qatar, Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al Thani, at the White House this Monday. During his visit, the Qatari leader is also expected to hold separate discussions with Vice President JD Vance. These high-level meetings highlight ongoing diplomatic engagements between the United States and Qatar.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ሰኞ ዕለት በኋይት ሀውስ የኳታሩን ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሼክ መሐመድ ቢን አብዱልረህማን አል ታኒን በግል እንደሚያነጋግሩ ይጠበቃል። በዚሁ ጉብኝት ወቅት የኳታሩ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ከምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄዲ ቫንስ ጋር እንደሚመክሩም ታውቋል። እነዚህ ከፍተኛ የልዑካን ውይይቶች በአሜሪካ እና በኳታር መካከል ያለውን የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት የሚያሳዩ ናቸው።
oromo: Pirezidaanti Doonaald Tiraamp Dilbata kana Mana Qulqulluu (White House) keessatti Ministira Muummee Qaataar Sheek Mohaammad biin Abdurraahmaan Al-Taanii waliin walarganii mari'achuuf karoorfataniiru. Daawwannaa kana keessatti, hogganaan Qaataar kun Itti Aanaa Pirezidaantii Jeey Dii Vaans waliinis marii addaa akka godhan eegama. Mariin sadarkaa olaanaa kun hariiroo diippiloomaasii Ameerikaafi Qaataar gidduu jiru kan ibsuudha.

title: Aramco Tower hit in heart of Saudi capital as Houthis launch fresh strikes
english: The Houthi rebel group launched an aerial attack on a prominent Aramco building in the center of Riyadh, causing structural damage. While Saudi officials claimed the impact was minimal with no casualties, video evidence indicates significant destruction to the tower. These strikes occur amidst escalating regional tensions, serving as retaliation for recent Saudi-led coalition actions in Yemen.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ዋና ከተማ ሪያድ በሚገኘው የአራምኮ ሕንፃ ላይ የአየር ጥቃት ሰንዝረዋል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ መጠነኛ ጉዳት ብቻ እንዳደረሰ እና የሰው ህይወት እንዳልጠፋ ቢገልጹም፣ የተለቀቁ ምስሎች በህንፃው ላይ የደረሰውን ጉዳት ከባድነት ያሳያሉ። ይህ ጥቃት በየመን እየተካሄደ ካለው ግጭት ጋር ተያይዞ በሁለቱ ወገኖች መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: gareen qabsaa'ota Huutii jedhamu magaalaa guddoo Saudii Arabiyaa, Riyaaditti gamoo Aramco irratti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwateera. Mootummaan Saudii miidhaan gahuu isaa fi lubbuun namaa darbuu isaa haalus, vidiyoon dhimmicha irratti bahe miidhaan gamoo sana irra gahuu isaa agarsiisa. Haleellaan kun waraana Yaman keessatti geggeeffamaa jiruun walqabatee rakkoon gama lameenii gidduu jiru hammaachuu kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Drone attack suspends production at Iraq’s Khor Mor gasfield
english: A drone strike on the Khor Mor gas field in Iraq’s semi-autonomous Kurdish region has ignited a fire and forced a halt to production. The attack significantly disrupted the regional power grid, leaving over 70 percent of the area without electricity. Authorities are currently investigating the incident, while emergency measures are being taken to maintain power for essential services like hospitals.
amharic: በኢራቅ የኩርድ ክልል በሚገኘው የኮር ሞር የጋዝ ማምረቻ ማዕከል ላይ በደረሰ የድሮን ጥቃት የእሳት አደጋ ተከስቶ የምርት ሂደቱ ተቋርጧል። ጥቃቱ የክልሉን የኤሌክትሪክ አቅርቦት በእጅጉ በመጉዳቱ ከ70 በመቶ በላይ የሚሆነው አካባቢ ያለ መብራት ቀርቷል። ባለሥልጣናት የጥቃቱን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ እንደ ሆስፒታሎች ላሉ አስፈላጊ አገልግሎቶች መብራት እንዲኖር አማራጭ እርምጃዎች እየተወሰዱ ነው።
oromo: Irak keessatti bakka gaazii ‘Khor Mor’ jedhamutti boombii tiraaniin (drone) ergame miidhaa geessiseen ibidni ka’ee hojiin dhaabbateera. Haleellaan kun humna ibsaa naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumee, harki 70 ol ta’u ibsaa malee hafeera. Aangeyyotni haleellaa kana qorachaa jiru, yeroo ammaa kana garuu tajaajila barbaachisaa kanneen akka hospitaalotaaf ibsaan akka hin kutamne tattaaffiin taasifamaa jira.

title: India’s night lights up for Diwali
english: India is currently celebrating Diwali, which is widely known as the annual festival of lights. During this major Hindu occasion, people across the country engage in vibrant festivities including religious prayers and spectacular fireworks displays. The celebration serves as a significant cultural highlight that illuminates the nation.
amharic: ህንድ በአሁኑ ወቅት የብርሃን በዓል በመባል የሚታወቀውን ዲዋሊን እያከበረች ነው። በዚሁ ታላቅ የሂንዱ እምነት ተከታዮች በዓል ላይ መላው የሀገሪቱ ህዝብ በጸሎት፣ በደማቅ መብራቶች እና በአምሮ የርችት ድግሶች ይሳተፋሉ። ይህ በዓል ሀገሪቱን በብርሃን የሚያደምቅ ትልቅ ባህላዊ ክንውን ነው።
oromo: Indiyaan yeroo ammaa kana ayyaana Diwaalii ykn ayyaana ibsaa jedhamuun beekamu kabajaa jirti. Ayyaana guddaa amantii Hinduu kana irratti, namoonni guutummaa biyyattii keessa jiran kadhataa, ibsaa fi qabsiisaa babbadaa ta'een gammachuu isaanii ibsatu. Ayyaanichi biyyattii guutuu kan ifsiisu fi kabaja guddaa kan qabuudha.

title: Jeffries backs Hegseth impeachment as Democrats vow probes of Trump allies
english: House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries has officially endorsed the impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, accusing him of misusing power and mishandling the conflict in Iran. Following a decisive Democratic victory in the midterm elections, party leaders intend to launch aggressive investigations into the Trump administration. Jeffries promised that the new Democratic majority will prioritize addressing government corruption and economic concerns during their first 100 days in power.
amharic: የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት አናሳ መሪ ሃኪም ጄፍሪስ የመከላከያ ሚኒስትሩን ፒት ሄግሴትን በስልጣን অপአላግባብ መጠቀም እና ኢራን ውስጥ በተፈጠረው ግጭት ላይ ባደረጉት የተሳሳተ አያያዝ ምክንያት ከስልጣን እንዲነሱ ድጋፋቸውን ሰጥተዋል። በምርጫው ያገኙትን ድል ተከትሎ ዲሞክራቶች በትራምፕ አስተዳደር ላይ ጠንካራ ምርመራዎችን ለመጀመር አቅደዋል። ጄፍሪስ አዲሱ የዲሞክራቶች የበላይነት በመንግስት ውስጥ ያለውን ሙስና እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ችግሮችን ለመቅረፍ በመጀመሪያዎቹ መቶ ቀናት ውስጥ በንቃት እንደሚሰሩ ቃል ገብተዋል።
oromo: Hogganaan garee xiqqaa mana maree bakka bu'oota uummataa Hakeem Jeffries, ministeera ittisa biyyaa Pete Hegseth aangoosaa ganda fayyadamuufi waraana Iraan irratti tarkaanfii dogoggoraa fudhachuu isaatiin himatamee akka aangoo irraa bu'u deggeraniiru. Injifannoo filannoo gidduu galeessaarratti argataniin booda, paartiin Demokraata mootummaa Donald Trump irratti qorannoo cimaa gaggeessuuf karoorfateera. Jeffries akka ibsetti, harka caaluu Demokraatonni argatan kanaan mootummaa keessatti malaammaltummaa fi rakkoolee dinagdee furuuf guyyoota dhibba jalqabaatti xiyyeeffannoo kennuuf waadaa galaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Trump says ‘Iron Gate’ in effect; drone hits Iraq gasfield
english: President Trump has announced that a new US land blockade on Iran is now active as tensions remain high. He plans to meet with the leaders of China and Russia to discuss potential denuclearization and the ongoing conflict. Meanwhile, a drone strike in Iraqi Kurdistan has caused an explosion at a gas field, leading to a temporary halt in production.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለው ውጥረት እየጨመረ በመምጣቱ አዲሱ የአሜሪካ የምድር ላይ እገዳ ተግባራዊ መሆኑን አስታውቀዋል። ከቻይና እና ከሩሲያ መሪዎች ጋር በኑክሌር ትጥቅ ማስፈታት እና አሁን ባለው ግጭት ዙሪያ ለመነጋገር እቅድ አላቸው። በሌላ በኩል በኢራቅ ኩርዲስታን በሚገኝ የጋዝ ማውጫ ቦታ ላይ በድሮን ጥቃት በመድረሱ የምርት ስራው ለጊዜው ተቋርጧል።
oromo: Pireezidaant Tiraamp dhiibbaan gama lafaa Ameerikaan Iraan irratti kaa’uuf karoorfatte hojiirra ooluusaa ibsaniiru. Dhimma nukleerii fi walitti bu’iinsa jiru irratti mari’achuuf gaggeessitoota Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaa waliin wal arguuf qophaa’aa jiru. Gamtaan biroo, biyya Iraaq naannoo Kurdiistaanitti bakka gaazii baasu tokko irratti miidhaan dorooneen geessifame hojii omishaa yeroof akka dhaabbatu godheera.

title: Nvidia CEO’s affair sparks Chinese espionage probe
english: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has acknowledged a personal relationship with a woman who is currently under investigation for potential espionage on behalf of China. While the company has initiated its own internal probe into the matter, they maintain that no confidential corporate data was compromised. Nvidia continues to monitor the situation to ensure their security remains intact.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁዋንግ ከቻይና ጋር በመተባበር ሰላይ ሊሆኑ ይችላሉ ከተባሉ ሴት ጋር የነበራቸውን ግንኙነት አምነዋል። ኩባንያው ጉዳዩን በውስጥ ምርመራ እያጣራ ቢሆንም፣ እስካሁን ምንም አይነት ሚስጥራዊ የኩባንያ መረጃ መውጣቱን የሚያሳይ ማስረጃ እንደሌለ አስታውቋል። የድርጅቱ ደህንነት አለመደፍረሱን ለማረጋገጥ ኩባንያው ሁኔታውን በቅርበት እየተከታተለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Nvidia Jensen Huang, dubartii shakkii basaasummaa Chaayinaatiin qabamtee jirtu tokko waliin hariiroo akka qabu beeksiseera. Dhaabbatichi dhimma kana irratti qorannoo keessoo kan jalqabe yoo ta'u, hanga ammaatti odeeffannoon icitii kamiyyuu akka hin baane mirkaneesseera. Nvidia nageenyummaan dhaabbatichaa kan hin tuqamne ta'uu isaa mirkaneeffachuuf haala jiru hordofaa jira.

title: Lopez double fires Barcelona to win at Atletico Madrid
english: Fermin Lopez scored two goals to help Barcelona defeat Atletico Madrid 2-1 after trailing early in the match. This important victory puts Barcelona three points ahead of Real Madrid at the top of the La Liga standings. The team successfully overcame a difficult start to maintain their winning streak against Atletico away from home.
amharic: ፈርሚን ሎፔዝ ሁለት ግቦችን በማስቆጠር ባርሴሎና በአትሌቲኮ ማድሪድ ላይ 2 ለ 1 እንዲያሸንፍ አስችሎታል። ይህ ወሳኝ ድል ባርሴሎናን ከሪያል ማድሪድ በሦስት ነጥብ ብልጫ የላሊጋው አናት ላይ አስቀምጦታል። ባርሴሎናም በመጀመሪያ ተቆጥሮበት የነበረውን ጎል በመቀልበስ በአትሌቲኮ ሜዳ ላይ ድሉን ተቀዳጅቷል።
oromo: Fermin Lopez goolii lama lakkoofsiisuun Barcelona tapha Atletico Madrid irratti 2-1 akka injifattu gargaareera. Injifannoon kun Barcelona sadarkaa La Ligaa irratti Real Madrid irraa qabxii sadiin akka dursitu taasiseera. Barcelona jalqaba goolii itti lakkoofsisullee, haala rakkisaa keessaa bahuun injifannoo kana galmeeffachuu danda'eera.

title: President Milei welcomes Pope Leo during historic visit to Argentina
english: Pope Leo XIV has arrived in Argentina for a historic visit, marking the first time a pontiff has traveled to the country in nearly forty years. President Javier Milei greeted the Pope at the airport despite ongoing disagreements between the government and the Church regarding recent economic austerity policies. The visit takes place as the Catholic Church faces a decline in membership across the region and political friction over the country's social welfare budget cuts.
amharic: ርዕሰ ሊቃነ ጳጳሳት ሊዮ ዐሥራ አራተኛ ለአርጀንቲና ታሪካዊ ጉብኝት አድርገዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት ሊቀ ጳጳሳት ለአርጀንቲና ያደረጉት የመጀመሪያው ጉብኝት በቅርብ አርባ ዓመታት ውስጥ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ ነው። ፕሬዚዳንት ጃቪየር ሚሌይ መንግስታቸው የኢኮኖሚ ቁጠባ እርምጃዎችን በመውሰዱ ከቤተክርስቲያኑ ጋር አለመግባባት ቢኖርም ሊቀ ጳጳሳቱን አቀባበል አድርገውላቸዋል።
oromo: Paaphaasii Leo 14ffaan biyya Arjantiinaatti daawwannaa seena qabeessa ta'e kan geggeessan yoo ta'u, kunis waggoota 40 keessatti kan jalqabaati. Pirezidaanti Jaaviyar Miileyi, mootummaan isaanii seera diinagdee cimaa hojiirra oolchuun walqabatee walitti bu'iinsi waldaa kiristaanaa wajjin jiraatus, paaphaasicha buufata xiyyaaraatti simataniiru. Daawwannaan kunis waldaan kiristaanaa biyyattii keessatti guddina xiqqaa argachaa fi rakkoo siyaasaa keessa jirutti taasifameera.

title: US chipmaker Nvidia investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair
english: Nvidia has launched an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following his admission of an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese intelligence operative. Although the board currently trusts Huang’s leadership and has no evidence that company secrets or national security were breached, they are conducting the inquiry to ensure transparency. This situation follows allegations that the woman used her connection to Huang to gather sensitive information, prompting significant concern among US lawmakers.
amharic: የኤንቪዲያ (Nvidia) ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ጄንሰን ሁአንግ ከቻይና ሰላይ ጋር ግንኙነት እንደነበራቸው በማመናቸው ኩባንያው ገለልተኛ ምርመራ ጀምሯል። የኩባንያው ቦርድ በአሁኑ ወቅት በዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚው ላይ እምነት እንዳለው ቢገልጽም፣ የድርጅቱ ሚስጥራዊ መረጃዎች ወይም የሀገር ደህንነት መጣሱን ለማጣራት ምርመራው አስፈላጊ ሆኗል። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው ተጠርጣሪዋ ሴት ስለ ኤንቪዲያ ቴክኖሎጂ መረጃ ለመሰብሰብ ሞክራለች በሚል በተነሳው ውዝግብ ምክንያት ሲሆን፣ ጉዳዩ በአሜሪካ የህግ አውጪዎች ዘንድ ትልቅ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni dhaabbata Nvidia, hoji gaggeessaa isaanii Jensen Huang dubartii akka ispeeshii Chaayinaatti shakkamtu tokko waliin hariiroo qabaachuu isaanii erga mirkaneeffatanii booda qorannoo walabaa jalqabaniiru. Yaa’iin dhaabbatichaa ammayyuu hogganaa isaanii irratti amantaa qabaachuu fi iccitiin dhaabbatichaa ykn nageenyi biyyaa miidhamuu isaa hanga ammaa ragaan akka hin jirre ibseera. Qorannoon kun kan godhame dubartittiin kun odeeffannoo teeknoolojii Nvidia walitti qabuuf hariiroo kana fayyadamteetti shakkii jedhuufi kanneen biroo ifa godhuufi.

title: Why Trump wants UFC chief Dana White as his new White House press secretary
english: President Donald Trump has offered UFC CEO Dana White the position of White House press secretary following recent political setbacks for his party. The two men, who share a long-standing personal and business relationship, are scheduled to meet to discuss the potential appointment. While White has expressed interest by posting about the role, he also noted that his current professional commitments might pose a challenge to taking the job.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በፓርቲያቸው የደረሰውን ሽንፈት ተከትሎ የUFC ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ የሆኑትን ዳና ዋይትን የዋይት ሀውስ የፕሬስ ፀሐፊ እንዲሆኑ ጠይቀዋል። ለረጅም ዓመታት የቆየ የንግድ እና የግል ግንኙነት ያላቸው ሁለቱ ወገኖች፣ ስለዚሁ የሥራ ዕድል ለመነጋገር በቅርቡ ለመገናኘት ቀጠሮ ይዘዋል። ዳና ዋይት በጉዳዩ ላይ ፍላጎት እንዳለው የሚያሳዩ ምልክቶችን ቢሰጥም፣ አሁን ላይ ያሉበት የሥራ ጫና ለዚህ አዲስ ኃላፊነት እንቅፋት ሊሆን እንደሚችል ገልጿል።
oromo: Pireezidanti Doonaald Tiraamp, paartii isaanii mudate injifannoo dhabuu booda, hogganaa UFC Daanaa Waayititti akka barreessaa miidiyaa Mana Adii ta'an gaaffii dhiyeessaniiru. Namoonni kun lamaan hariiroo daldalaa fi dhuunfaa dheeraa kan qaban yoo ta'u, dhimma kana irratti mari'achuuf wal arguuf qophaa'aa jiru. Daanaa Waayit iddoo kana irratti fedhii akka qabu ibsuus, hojiileen isaa yeroo ammaa qabate itti gaafatamummaa haaraa kana fudhachuuf rakkoo ta'uu akka danda'an dubbateera.

title: Deadly sand cliff collapses on displaced families in Gaza
english: A tragic incident occurred in Gaza when a sand cliff collapsed onto tents where displaced families were seeking shelter. At least five individuals, including several children, lost their lives in the disaster. This event highlights the extreme dangers faced by civilians who have been forced to relocate due to the ongoing conflict.
amharic: ጋዛ ውስጥ ተፈናቃይ ቤተሰቦች መጠለያ በተጠለሉበት ድንኳኖች ላይ የአሸዋ ድንጋይ በመደርመሱ አሳዛኝ አደጋ ደርሷል። በዚህ አደጋ ህጻናትን ጨምሮ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ይህ ክስተት በግጭቱ ምክንያት ቤት ለሌላቸው ንጹሃን ዜጎች የተጋረጠውን ከፍተኛ አደጋ ያሳያል።
oromo: Gaazaatti maatiin buqqa'anii godoo keessa jiraatan irratti gaarri biyyee waan kufuuf balaa gaddisiisaa ta'e tokko uumameera. Balaa kanaan ijoollee dabalatee namoonni shan ol ta'an lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Taateen kun namoota walitti buiinsa kanaan sababii godhatanii iddoo tokko irraa gara kaaniitti godaanan irratti balaan hangam ulfaataa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: Surgeon having lunch near Krakow shooting undoubtedly saved officer's life, colleague says
english: Two surgeons eating lunch in Krakow rushed to provide emergency medical aid when a gunman opened fire near the city center, killing six people and injuring fifteen. One of the doctors is credited with saving a police officer's life by performing critical wound care while waiting for an ambulance. Authorities are investigating the mass shooting, which involved a 24-year-old suspect motivated by far-right extremist views.
amharic: በክራኮው ከተማ የጦር መሳሪያ የታጠቀ ሰው ጥቃት ባደረሰበት ወቅት፣ ምሳ እየበሉ የነበሩ ሁለት የቀዶ ጥገና ሐኪሞች ፈጥነው በመድረስ የቆሰሉ ሰዎችን ህይወት ታድገዋል። ከሐኪሞቹ አንዱ በጥይት የተመታ የፖሊስ መኮንን ላይ አስቸኳይ ህክምና በማድረግ ህይወቱን ማትረፍ እንደቻለ ተገልጿል። በስድስት ሰዎች ሞት እና በአስራ አምስት ሰዎች መቁሰል ምክንያት የሆነው ይህ ጥቃት፣ በጽንፈኛ አስተሳሰብ የተነሳሳ የሽብር ጥቃት መሆኑ እየተጣራ ይገኛል።
oromo: Magala Krakaw keessatti nama meeshaa waraanaa hidhateen dhukaasa banameen lubbuun namoota jahaa darbee kanneen biroo kudha shaniin madaa'anii jiru. Yeroo balaan kun gahuu, ogeeyyonni baqaqsanii hodhuu lama bakka sana nyaata nyaachaa turan battalatti ariifatanii madaa'ota gargaaruun lubbuu qondaala poolisii tokkoo oolchaniiru. Balaa kana kan raawwate dargaggeessa waggaa 24 akka ta'eefi gochi kun yaada fira qolqolii (far-right) irratti kan hundaa'e tahuun qorannoon eegalameera.

title: Seven dead and more than 100 injured after trains collide in Egypt
english: A serious train collision near Giza, Egypt, has resulted in at least seven deaths and over 100 injuries. The accident occurred when a moving train crashed into the back of a stationary train, causing several carriages to derail and overturn. Egyptian authorities have launched an official investigation into the cause of the disaster, while local hospitals remain on high alert to treat the many victims.
amharic: በግብፅ ጊዛ አቅራቢያ በተከሰተው የባቡር ግጭት ቢያንስ ሰባት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ ከ100 በላይ ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። አደጋው የደረሰው አንድ ባቡር በባቡር ሀዲድ ላይ ቆሞ የነበረን ሌላ ባቡር ሲገጭ ሲሆን፣ በዚህም ምክንያት በርካታ ሰረገላዎች ከሀዲዳቸው በመውጣት ገደል ውስጥ ገብተዋል። የግብፅ ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ በአካባቢው ያሉ ሆስፒታሎችም ለተጎጂዎች ህክምና ከፍተኛ ዝግጅት እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Masrii magaalaa Giizaa biratti balaa baaburaa mudateen namoonni torba yoo du'an, 100 ol ammoo miidhamaniiru. Balaan kun kan mudate yeroo baaburti deemtu tokko baabura dhaabbataa ture duubaan yeroo buutu ta'ee, kunis gaariileen baaburaa baay'een akka karkaarraatti gadi bahanii gombifaman godheera. Mootummaan Masrii balaa kana qorachuuf hojiirra jiraachuu beeksiseera; hospitaalonni naannichas namoota miidhaman wal'aanuuf of eeggannoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Homes and temples glow across India to mark Diwali
english: Millions of people across India are celebrating Diwali, the festival of lights, which commemorates the victory of good over evil through prayer, decorations, and family gatherings. However, this year's festivities are overshadowed by severe air pollution, particularly in Delhi, where smog levels have reached a ten-year high. To address environmental concerns, the Supreme Court has limited fireworks to specific eco-friendly versions, though their effectiveness remains a topic of debate.
amharic: በህንድ ሚሊዮኖች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች የብርሃን በዓል የሆነውን ዲዋሊን በጸሎት፣ በቤተሰብ ስብሰባ እና በደማቅ የቤት ማስዋቢያዎች እያከበሩ ይገኛሉ። ይሁን እንጂ የዘንድሮው በዓል በተለይም በዴልሂ በደረሰው ከፍተኛ የአየር ብክለት ምክንያት ተግዳሮት ገጥሞታል። የአካባቢ ብክለትን ለመቀነስ የህንድ ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት ለአካባቢ ጥበቃ ተስማሚ የሆኑ ርችቶችን ብቻ እንዲጠቀሙ ቢፈቅድም፣ ይህ እርምጃ ውጤታማነቱ አጠያያቂ ሆኗል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman ayyaana ifaa kan ta'e 'Diwaalii' kadhannaa, walgahii maatii fi miidhagina manaa garaagaraan kabajaa jiru. Haa ta'u malee, ayyaanni kun bara kana qilleensa faajjeeffamee fi aara hamaa keessa kan jiru si'a ta'u, keessattuu magaalaa Deelhi keessatti guddinni faalama qilleensaa kan waggaa kudhan duraa irra caalee argameera. Rakkoo kana hir'isuuf mana murtii olaanaa Indiyaatti uummataaf kan hin miine ibidda dhukaasuuf hayyamamuyyuu, bu'aan isaa garuu gaaffii keessa galeera.

title: Iran executes three men for 'armed unrest' after January protests
english: Iranian authorities have executed three men convicted of engaging in armed violence during anti-government protests held earlier this year in the city of Karaj. The men were accused of using weapons, damaging public infrastructure, and collaborating with foreign entities to incite unrest. These executions follow a series of similar lethal sentences carried out by the state in response to widespread demonstrations.
amharic: የኢራን ባለስልጣናት በካራጅ ከተማ በተካሄዱ ፀረ-መንግስት ተቃውሞዎች ወቅት የታጠቁ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽመዋል በሚል የተከሰሱ ሶስት ሰዎችን የሞት ፍርድ ፈጽመዋል። ግለሰቦቹ የጦር መሳሪያ በመጠቀም፣ የህዝብ ተቋማትን በማውደም እና አለመረጋጋትን ለመፍጠር ከውጭ ኃይሎች ጋር በመተባበር ተከሰው ነበር። እነዚህ ግድያዎች መንግስት በስፋት ከተነሱ ተቃውሞዎች ጋር በተያያዘ በቅርቡ ከወሰዳቸው ተከታታይ የቅጣት እርምጃዎች መካከል የሚካተቱ ናቸው።
oromo: Mootummaan Iraan namoota sadii kanneen magaala Karaajitti walgahii mormii mootummaa irratti haleellaa hidhannoon geggeessaniiru jedhamanii himataman ajjeeseera. Namoonni kunneen meeshaa waraana fayyadamuu, qabeenya ummataa barbadeessuu fi nagaa fi tasgabbii booriisuuf jecha humnoota alaa wajjin ta’uun himatamu turan. Ajjeechaan kun tarkaanfii mootummaan mormiiwwan biyyoolessaa guutuu irratti fudhachaa jiru keessaa kan dhihoo ti.

title: Al Jazeera tries Baseball5 at Youth Olympics
english: Al Jazeera journalist Nic Haque visited the 2026 Youth Olympics in Senegal to experience new sports firsthand. He teamed up with French athletes to learn the basics of Baseball5, a fast-paced variation of traditional baseball. This event is historically significant as it marks the first time an Olympic competition has taken place on the African continent.

english: Manchester United managed a dramatic 4-4 draw against Aston Villa after scoring two late goals during stoppage time. Despite this comeback, the team remains in the relegation zone, sitting in 18th place after a difficult start to the season. This result provides temporary relief for manager Michael Carrick, whose position has been under significant pressure following a series of poor performances.

title: After the midterms, where does the Republican Party stand?
english: In the recent US midterm elections, the Democratic Party achieved a significant victory by gaining control of both the House of Representatives and the Senate. Voters expressed their dissatisfaction with the current national direction, largely driven by economic struggles like rising fuel and food prices resulting from the war with Iran. This shift in power means Democrats now hold the authority to launch investigations into the Trump administration and will significantly influence legislative priorities for the next two years.

title: Carlos Alcaraz beats Ben Shelton to win Paris Masters tennis title
english: Carlos Alcaraz secured his first Paris Masters title by defeating Ben Shelton in straight sets. This victory serves as a comeback for the Spaniard, who had previously lost to Shelton at the US Open earlier this year. With this win, Alcaraz adds a ninth 1000-level title to his career and heads into the upcoming ATP Finals in strong form.

title: Eisenkot open to Netanyahu joining Israel’s next government
english: Gadi Eisenkot has been officially tasked with forming Israel's next government and is open to including his political rival, Benjamin Netanyahu, in a potential coalition. Despite leading the opposition, Eisenkot needs to bridge the gap between his alliance and other parties to secure a parliamentary majority. President Isaac Herzog emphasized the urgent need for a stable government to navigate the changing political landscape in the United States.

The incoming government faces the difficult task of addressing deep-seated concerns regarding the cost of living, declining economic prospects, and a waning sense of national optimism.

title: Saudi Arabia intercepts Houthi missiles targeting Riyadh, Eastern province
english: Saudi Arabia’s air defense systems successfully intercepted several ballistic and cruise missiles launched by Houthi forces toward Riyadh and the Eastern province. These attacks occur amid escalating violence in Yemen, where government forces are attempting to reclaim territory from the rebels. Simultaneously, Houthi officials reported that a coalition airstrike near Sanaa resulted in the deaths of 33 civilians, including many women and children.

title: Photos: Heavy rains leave tens of thousands without shelter in Gaza
english: Severe rainfall has flooded tens of thousands of makeshift tents across Gaza, leaving many displaced families without adequate shelter. Local emergency services are struggling to provide aid due to a critical lack of equipment and the ongoing restrictions on humanitarian support. Authorities have issued an urgent plea to international organizations for immediate assistance to address the deepening crisis.
