title: Is unconditional support for Israel becoming a liability for Republicans?
english: Following a significant defeat in the recent midterm elections, some Republican leaders are questioning the party's long-standing policy of unconditional support for Israel. Vice President JD Vance explicitly identified concerns over the U.S.-Israel relationship as a factor that drove voters away from the party. This shift suggests that the traditional Republican consensus on foreign policy may be changing as the party evaluates its future political strategy.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የመሃል ዘመን ምርጫ ያጋጠማቸው ከባድ ሽንፈት ተከትሎ፣ አንዳንድ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ መሪዎች ለእስራኤል የሚሰጠው ያልተገደበ ድጋፍ እንዲመረመር እያደረጉ ነው። ምክትል ፕሬዝዳንት ጄ ዲ ቫንስ፣ በአሜሪካና በእስራኤል ግንኙነት ላይ ያለው ቅሬታ መራጮች ፓርቲውን እንዲለቁ ካደረጉት ምክንያቶች አንዱ እንደሆነ በግልፅ ተናግረዋል። ይህ ለውጥ ፓርቲው ለወደፊት የፖለቲካ ስትራቴጂው ሲል ባህላዊ የውጭ ፖሊሲውን እንደገና ለመገምገም እየተዘጋጀ መሆኑን ያሳያል።
oromo: Filannoo giddu-galeessa waggaa dhiheenya kana gaggeeffame irratti injifannoo dhabuun hordofee, hogganoonni paartii Ripaabilikaanii tokko tokko deeggarsa Israa'eliif taasisan kan hin miiroomne ta'uu isaa irratti shakkii kaasaa jiru. Itti aantuun pirezidaantii Jii Dii Vaans akka ibsetti, hariiroo Ameerikaa fi Israa'el irratti rakkoon jiraachuun isaa namoonni paartichaa deeggaruurraa akka of qusatan taasiseera. Jijjiiramni kun, paartichi fuulduratti duula filannoo isaa irratti milkaa'uuf jecha imaammata isaa keessatti jijjiirama gochuuf murteessuu isaa agarsiisa.

title: There is reason to hope that the Democrats might deliver this time
english: Following the recent US midterm elections, voters have provided the Democratic Party with a renewed opportunity after rejecting Trumpism. The author notes that Democrats achieved success by focusing more on progressive economic populism and supporting working-class interests rather than traditional neoliberal policies. Success in future cycles now depends on whether the party can effectively deliver on these promises to avoid further voter backlash.
amharic: በቅርቡ በተካሄደው የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ መራጮች የትራምፕን አስተሳሰብ ውድቅ በማድረግ ለዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲ ሌላ እድል ሰጥተዋል። ደራሲው እንደሚገልጸው ዴሞክራቶች ስኬታማ የሆኑት ከቀድሞው የኒዮሊበራል ፖሊሲዎች በመውጣት ለሰራተኛው ክፍል በሚጠቅሙ የኢኮኖሚ ጉዳዮች ላይ በማተኮራቸው ነው። ፓርቲው የገባውን ቃል በተግባር ካላሳየ ግን ወደፊት ለተመሳሳይ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ሊጋለጥ እንደሚችል ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Filannoo gidduu waggaa Ameerikaa kanaan booda, filattoonni yaada Tramp mormuun paartii Demookraatotaaf carraa biraa kennaniiru. Barreessaan akka ibsetti, Demookraatonni bu'aa argatan kan danda'ame ilaalcha diinagdee gara fuulduraatti tarkaanfatuufi faayidaa hojjettootaarratti xiyyeeffachuudhaan malee, siyaasa durii hordofuudhaan miti. Paartichi abdii kenne kana qabatamaan raawwachuu baannaan, gara fuulduraatti mormii filattootaa akkaan mudachuu danda'a.

title: Haitians cheer El Salvador’s Bukele amid gang war
english: Many Haitians are expressing support for El Salvador’s President Nayib Bukele as he considers intervening in Haiti's severe gang crisis. This interest follows Bukele's commitment to dismantle criminal organizations after several Salvadoran citizens were abducted. Residents in the violence-plagued capital are looking toward his aggressive security approach as a potential solution to restore order.
amharic: የሄይቲ ነዋሪዎች በሀገሪቱ የፈጠረውን የቡድን ወንጀል ለመቅረፍ የኤል ሳልቫዶሩ ፕሬዝዳንት ናይብ ቡኬሌ ጣልቃ እንዲገቡ ድጋፋቸውን እየገለጹ ነው። ይህ የሆነው አራት የኤል ሳልቫዶር ዜጎች ታግተው በመወሰዳቸው ምክንያት ፕሬዝዳንቱ ወንጀለኛ ቡድኖችን ሙሉ በሙሉ ለማጥፋት ቃል በመግባታቸው ነው። በወንጀለኞች ቁጥጥር ስር ለወደቀችው የሄይቲ ዋና ከተማ ነዋሪዎች፣ የፕሬዝዳንቱ ጠንካራ የጸጥታ እርምጃ መፍትሄ ይሆናል ብለው ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
oromo: Haitii keessatti namoonni baay'een mootummaan isaanii rakkoo garee yakkaatiin guutamuu isaa hordofee, pirezidaantiin El Saalvaadoor Nayib Bukele gargaarsa akka godhaniif deggersa isaanii ibsaa jiru. Kuni kan ta'e erga lammiileen El Saalvaadoor afur butamanii booda, pirezidaant Bukele garee yakkaatiin guutummaatti barbadeessuuf waadaa seenuun isaanii hordofeeti. Jiraattonni magaalaa guddittii badii garee yakkattiin miidhaman, tarkaanfiin nageenyaa kan pirezidaantichaa furmaata ta'a jedhanii abdatu.

title: Morning update
english: The Middle East is facing heightened tension as Saudi-led forces intercepted missile attacks near Riyadh, while civilian casualties rise from airstrikes in Yemen. The United States is launching a new task force to monitor Iranian weapon movements, leading to stern warnings from Iranian officials. Additionally, regional developments include an execution in Iran, maritime rescue operations in the Sea of Oman, and diplomatic discussions aimed at stabilizing the area.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያን የመሩት የጥምረት ኃይሎች በሪያድ ላይ የተተኮሱ ሚሳኤሎችን መትተው በመጣላቸው በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ውጥረት እየጨመረ ነው። በየመን በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት የበርካታ ሰላማዊ ሰዎች ህይወት ያለፈ ሲሆን፣ አሜሪካም የኢራንን የጦር መሳሪያ ዝውውር ለመግታት አዲስ የተግባር ቡድን አቋቁማለች። በሌላ በኩል ኢራን ለዚህ እርምጃ ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ አስታውቃለች፤ እንዲሁም በክልሉ የዲፕሎማሲያዊ ውይይቶች እና ሌሎች የደህንነት ክስተቶች እየተከናወኑ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Naannoo Baha Giddu-galeessatti humnoonni Sa’udii durfaman xiyyara gosa misaa’elaa biyya ishee irratti dhukaafame erga fashalsanii booda rakkoon tasgabbii dabalaa dhufeera. Yaman keessatti haleellaa qilleensaan lubbuun namoota baay’ee darbee kan jiru yoo ta’u, Ameerikaan ammoo sochii meeshaa waraanaa Iraan to’achuuf garee addaa hundeeffatteetti. Iraan tarkaanfii kanaan walqabatee akeekkachiisa cimaa kan kennite yoo ta’u, gama biraatiin mariin dippilomaasii fi haalli nageenyaa naannichaa xiyyeeffannoo argataa jira.

title: Palestinian injured, six others detained during raids in West Bank
english: Israeli forces conducted military raids across the West Bank, resulting in one Palestinian youth being shot and wounded in Qalqilya after clashes involving stone-throwing. During these operations, soldiers also damaged a private home and arrested six individuals in Jenin and near Nablus. The Israeli military confirmed they engaged targets following confrontations with local residents.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ አካባቢ ባደረጉት ወረራ አንድ ወጣት በካልኪሊያ ከተማ በጥይት ተመቷል። በዚህ ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ወቅት ወታደሮቹ የአንድን ቤተሰብ ቤት መውረራቸውንና ንብረት ማውደማቸውን የተዘገበ ሲሆን በጀኒን እና በናብሉስ አቅራቢያ ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያን ታስረዋል። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በከተማዋ ከተፈጠረው ድንጋይ የመወርወር ግጭት በኋላ ግለሰቦች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸሙን አረጋግጧል።
oromo: Humnoonni Israa'el naannoo Qaxxaamuraa Lixaa (West Bank) keessatti weerara gaggeessaniin dargaggeessi tokko magaalaa Qalqiyaa keessatti rasaasaan rukutamee madaa'eera. Hojiilee kana gidduutti, waraanni mana dhuunfaa tokko miidhuu fi namoota ja'a godina Jenin fi Nablus biratti qabuu gabaafameera. Humnoonni Israa'el garee namootaa dhagaa darbatan irratti tarkaanfii fudhachuu isaanii mirkaneessaniiru.

title: Aramco building damaged as Houthis target Riyadh, report says
english: A building belonging to the oil giant Aramco was damaged in Riyadh's financial district following a missile attack. While Saudi-led forces stated they successfully intercepted projectiles in the air, witnesses confirmed that the site suffered visible impacts. Loud explosions were heard throughout the capital city after authorities issued emergency warnings about the incoming threat.
amharic: በሪያድ የፋይናንስ ማዕከል የሚገኝ የአራምኮ ሕንፃ በደረሰ የሮኬት ጥቃት ጉዳት ደርሶበታል። የሳዑዲ ጥምረት ኃይሎች ሚሳይሎችን በአየር ላይ መትተው እንደጣሉ ቢገልጹም፣ በአካባቢው የነበሩ ምስክሮች በሕንፃው ላይ ጉዳት መድረሱን አረጋግጠዋል። ባለስልጣናት የደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያ ከሰጡ በኋላ በከተማዋ የተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ከፍተኛ የፍንዳታ ድምፆች ተሰምተዋል።
oromo: Masaraan dhaabbata boba'aa Aramco kan magaalatti Riyaad keessatti argamu, haleellaa rookeettiin iddoo kuusaa maallaqaa irratti raawwatameen miidhamuu gabaasameera. Humnoonni gamtaa Sa'udii rookeettiiwwan qilleensa keessatti akka barbadeessan dubbatanis, ragaan biyya lafaa miidhaa qaqqabe mirkaneessaniiru. Aangoonni biyyattii akeekkachiisa yeroo muddamaa erga labsanii booda, magaalaa guddoo sana keessatti sagaleen dhoohinsa cimaa dhaga'ameera.

title: UK petition seeking Gaza genocide inquiry nears parliament debate threshold
english: A petition in the UK urging a formal investigation into the country's role in the conflict in Gaza has gained 90,000 signatures. Once the total reaches 100,000, the proposal will be eligible for a mandatory debate in the British Parliament. Initiated by Your Party, the movement aims to hold government officials accountable for potential involvement in military actions, including arms sales and the use of air bases.
amharic: በዩናይትድ ኪንግደም በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ባለው ጦርነት የብሪታንያ ተሳትፎ ላይ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ የሚጠይቅ አቤቱታ 90,000 ፊርማዎችን አግኝቷል። አጠቃላይ ቁጥሩ 100,000 ሲደርስ ጉዳዩ በፓርላማ ተወያይቶበት ውሳኔ እንዲሰጥበት ይገደዳል። በ'ዩር ፓርቲ' የተጀመረው ይህ ጥረት መንግሥት የጦር መሣሪያ አቅርቦትንና ሌሎች ወታደራዊ እገዛዎችን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ ጉዳዮች ላይ ተጠያቂ እንዲሆን ይፈልጋል።
oromo: UK keessatti gaaffiin qorannoo irratti godhamuu qabu kan biyyattiin waraana Gaaza keessatti qabdu adda baasuuf gargaaru 90,000 gaheera. Walumaagalatti mallattoon 100,000 yoo guute, dhimmi kun parlamaan irratti akka mari'atuuf dirqama ta'a. 'Your Party'n kan jalqabame kun, mootummaan meeshaalee waraanaa dhiyeessuu fi gargaarsa waraanaa biroo irratti gaafatamaa akka ta'u gaafata.

title: Coalition forces says four Houthi missiles destroyed over Saudi airspace
english: The Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted four Houthi-launched missiles targeting various areas of Saudi Arabia, including Riyadh and the southern region. According to a coalition spokesperson, the defense systems destroyed two ballistic missiles and two cruise missiles mid-air. There were no reports of damage or casualties resulting from these thwarted aerial attacks.
amharic: በሳውዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ወደ ሳውዲ አረቢያ የተተኮሱ አራት ሚሳኤሎችን በአየር ላይ መትቶ ጥሏል። የጥምረቱ ቃል አቀባይ እንደገለጹት፣ ሁለቱ ባሊስቲክ እና ሁለቱ የክሩዝ ሚሳኤሎች በሪያድ እና በደቡባዊ የሳውዲ ክፍል ላይ ተintercept ተደርገው ተደምስሰዋል። በዚህ ጥቃት ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት ወይም የንብረት ውድመት አልተመዘገበም።
oromo: Mootummoota gamtoomaniin kan durfamu humni waraanaa, kombii Hutiin gara biyya Sa'udii Arabaatti ergaman miseelota afur qilleensa irratti caccabseera. Akka dubbi himaan humna waraana kanaa ibsetti, miseelota baalistikii lamaafi miseelota kiruuzii lama kanneen gara Riyaadiifi kibba biyyattii qajeelfaman qilleensa irratti fashala'aniiru. Haleellaa kanaan miidhaan lubbuufi qabeenyaa irra ga'e akka hin jirre ibsameera.

title: Gold-fed Cash Drags Treasury Yields Far Below the Policy Rate
english: The National Bank of Ethiopia is preparing for an upcoming monetary policy meeting to address the gap between its set interest rates and market borrowing costs. Recent treasury bill auctions and government gold purchasing plans are influencing liquidity and debt dynamics. Financial authorities are closely monitoring these economic factors to determine whether current policy rates remain aligned with real-world market conditions.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ ባስቀመጠው የወለድ መጠን እና በገበያ ላይ ባለው የመበደር ዋጋ መካከል ያለውን ልዩነት ለመገምገም ለሚቀጥለው የገንዘብ ፖሊሲ ስብሰባ እየተዘጋጀ ነው። በቅርቡ የተካሄዱ የጨረታ ውጤቶች እና የመንግስት የወርቅ ግዢ እቅዶች በገበያው ላይ ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ እያሳደሩ ይገኛሉ። የፋይናንስ ባለስልጣናት አሁን ያለው የፖሊሲ ወለድ መጠን ከገበያው ሁኔታ ጋር የተጣጣመ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ መረጃዎችን በቅርበት እየተከታተሉ ነው።
oromo: Baankiin Biyyaalessaa Itoophiyaa qabxii woliiggaltee qabxiilee dhabuu gatii liqii mootummaa fi qajeelfama baankichaa gidduu jiru fooyyessuuf mariiwwan fuulduraaf qophaa'aa jira. Ibsiwwan baajataa fi karoora bitii warqee mootummaa dhiyeenya kana raawwataman dhiyeessii maallaqaa fi gatii liqii irratti dhiibbaa uumaa jiru. Qaamoleen maallaqaa qajeelfamni amma jiru gabaa fi haala dinagdee biyyattii wajjin kan wal-simatu ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuuf haala qabatamaa gabaa hordofaa jiru.

title: A CITY THAT RATIONS WATER SELLS IT TWICE
english: Residents of Addis Ababa are facing severe water shortages, receiving tap water only once or twice a week. Because of this scarcity, families and small businesses are forced to spend significant money on expensive private water tankers and bottled water. Bottling companies claim that high costs for fuel, plastic, and taxes have made water prices increasingly unaffordable for the public.
amharic: የአዲስ አበባ ነዋሪዎች የቧንቧ ውሃ በሳምንት አንድ ወይም ሁለት ጊዜ ብቻ በማግኘታቸው ከፍተኛ የውሃ እጥረት እየገጠማቸው ነው። በዚህ ችግር ምክንያት ቤተሰቦችና ትናንሽ የንግድ ተቋማት ውድ የሆነ የውሃ ቦቴ እና የታሸገ ውሃ ለመግዛት ተገደዋል። የውሃ አምራች ኩባንያዎች በበኩላቸው የነዳጅ፣ የፕላስቲክ እና የታክስ ጭማሪ ዋጋው እንዲወደድ ማድረጉን ይገልጻሉ።
oromo: Jiraattonni Finfinnee bishaan burcuqqoo torbanitti al tokko ykn lama qofa argachaa waan jiraniif, rakkoo bishaan dhabuu hamaa keessa jiru. Hanqina kanaan kan ka’e, maatiinifi qonnaan bultoonni bishaan konkolataan dhuufuufi bishaan qaruuraatiif baasii guddaa baasuuf dirqamaniiru. Warreen bishaan qaruuraatti guuran ammoo gatiin boba'aa, pilaastikiifi taaksiin dabaluun isaa gatii bishaanichaa akka mi'aayu taasiseera jedhu.

title: Before WTO Entry, Ethiopia’s Quality System Faces a Test
english: Ethiopia is currently working toward joining the World Trade Organization, but it faces significant challenges in meeting global trade standards. A government official recently admitted that the country lacks the necessary modern laboratory equipment, skilled professionals, and institutional coordination to support businesses effectively. Addressing these infrastructure and capacity gaps is critical for the nation's successful integration into the international trade market.
amharic: ኢትዮጵያ የዓለም የንግድ ድርጅትን ለመቀላቀል ጥረት እያደረገች ቢሆንም፣ ዓለም አቀፍ የንግድ ደረጃዎችን ለማሟላት ከፍተኛ ፈተናዎች ገጥመዋታል። የመንግስት የስራ ኃላፊዎች እንደገለጹት አገሪቱ ንግድን በብቃት ለመደገፍ የሚያስፈልጉ ዘመናዊ የላብራቶሪ መሣሪያዎች፣ የሰለጠኑ ባለሙያዎች እና የተጠናከረ ተቋማዊ ትብብር እንደሌላት አምነዋል። እነዚህን የመሠረተ ልማት እና የአቅም ክፍተቶች መፍታት አገሪቱ በአለም አቀፍ የንግድ ስርዓት ውስጥ በተሳካ ሁኔታ ለመሳተፍ ወሳኝ ነው።
oromo: Itoophiyaan dhaabbata daldalaa addunyaa (WTO) makamuuf carraaqqii gochaa jirtus, sadarkaa daldalaa addunyaa guutuuf rakkoo guddaa keessa jirti. Akka qondaalonni mootummaa ibsanitti, biyyattiin daldala deeggaruuf meeshaalee laaboraatoorii ammayyaa, ogeeyyii gahumsa qaban fi walitti hidhamiinsa dhaabbilee barbaachisu akka hin qabne beekameera. Rakkoolee bu'uuraa fi dandeettii kana furuun, biyyattiin sirna daldala addunyaa keessatti milkaa'inaan akka hirmaattuuf baay'ee barbaachisaadha.

title: Regulators to Let Banks Guard Foreign Investors’ Assets without Subsidiaries
english: The Ethiopian Capital Market Authority and the National Bank are working on a new policy allowing commercial banks to act as custodians for foreign investors' assets. Under this proposed framework, banks would manage these securities within internal, isolated departments rather than having to create separate subsidiary companies. This shift aims to bypass previous restrictions that prevented banks from offering such capital market services directly.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ ካፒታል ገበያ ባለስልጣን እና የኢትዮጵያ ብሔራዊ ባንክ የንግድ ባንኮች ለውጭ ባለሀብቶች የንብረት ጠባቂነት አገልግሎት እንዲሰጡ የሚያስችል አዲስ መመሪያ እያዘጋጁ ነው። በዚህ አዲስ አሰራር መሰረት ባንኮቹ የተለየ ቅርንጫፍ ሳይከፍቱ በራሳቸው የውስጥ ክፍል ውስጥ የባለሀብቶችን ደህንነቶች በጥንቃቄ መያዝ ይችላሉ። ይህ እርምጃ ባንኮች በቀጥታ የካፒታል ገበያ አገልግሎት እንዳይሰጡ የሚከለክለውን ቀደም ሲል የነበረውን ገደብ ለማሻሻል ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Abbaan taayitaa gabaa kaappitaalaa Itoophiyaa fi Baankiin Biyyooleessa Itoophiyaa, baankonni daldalaa qabeenya invastoroota alaa akka eegan hayyamuuf qajeelfama haaraa qopheessaa jiru. Haala kana jalatti, baankonni garee addaa ykn 'subsidiary' osoo hin hundeesseen, qabeenya invastorootaa keessa isaaniitti bakka adda baafamee fi eegame keessatti bulchuu danda'u. Jijjiiramni kun, kanaan dura baankonni tajaajila gabaa kaappitaalaa qajeeltodhaan akka hin kennine dhorkaa ture haquuf kan yaadame dha.

title: Fed Cushions Oil Shock with Money Already in the Pipeline
english: The Ethiopian government is managing the impact of rising oil prices by repurposing 543 million dollars from existing World Bank development funds. This strategy aims to stabilize domestic fuel supplies and maintain the flow of critical imports without requiring new emergency loans. The allocated amount is valued at approximately 86.7 billion Birr based on current exchange rates.
amharic: የኢትዮጵያ መንግስት በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የተከሰተውን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረት ተፅእኖ ለመቀነስ ቀደም ሲል ከዓለም ባንክ የተገኘን 543 ሚሊዮን ዶላር ወደ ነዳጅ አቅርቦት ስራዎች በማዞር ላይ ይገኛል። ይህ እርምጃ አዲስ የብድር እዳ ሳይወስድ የሀገር ውስጥ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት መስተጓጎልን ለመቅረፍ እና አስፈላጊ የሆኑ የውጭ ምርቶች በየጊዜው እንዲገቡ ለማስቻል ታስቦ የተዘጋጀ ነው። የተጠቀሰው ገንዘብ አሁን ባለው የምንዛሬ ተመን ወደ 86.7 ቢሊዮን ብር ገደማ ይገመታል።
oromo: Mootummaan Itoophiyaa miidhaa gabaa boba'aa giddu galeessa bahaa irraa dhufu hir'isuuf, maallaqa World Bank irraa argamee fi pirojektoota misoomaa adda addaaf qabame ture miiliyoona 543 gara dhiyeessii boba'aatti jijjiirachaa jira. Tarkaanfiin kun liqii haaraa osoo hin fudhatin dhiyeessii boba'aa biyya keessaa tasgabbeessuu fi meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an gara biyyaa galchuuf kan gargaaru dha. Maallaqni kun yeroo ammaa gatii jijjiirraa maallaqaan yoo shallagamu gara biliyoona 86.7 ta'a.

title: Canary Islands’ El Hierro declares emergency amid migrant, refugee influx
english: The Canary Island of El Hierro has officially declared an emergency due to a massive surge in migrants arriving by boat from West Africa. Since early November, over 3,300 people have reached the island, severely straining local medical facilities and resources. Regional leaders are calling for urgent support from the Spanish central government to manage the unsustainable situation and provide adequate care for the new arrivals.
amharic: የስፔኑ የካናሪ ደሴት የሆነችው ኤል ሂሮ ከምዕራብ አፍሪካ በጀልባ የሚመጡ ስደተኞች ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ በመጨመሩ የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ አዋጅ አውጇል። ከህዳር ወር መጀመሪያ አንስቶ ከ3,300 በላይ ሰዎች ደሴቲቱ ላይ በመድረሳቸው የጤና ተቋማት እና የአካባቢው ሀብቶች ከፍተኛ ጫና ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። የክልሉ አስተዳዳሪዎች ሁኔታው አሳሳቢ እና የማይቀጥል መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ከስፔን ማዕከላዊ መንግስት አስቸኳይ እርዳታ ጠይቀዋል።
oromo: Odolli Ispeen kan ta'e El Hiyeroo, godaantotni Afrikaa Dhihaa irraa dooniin dhufan lakkoofsaan dabaluu isaatiin walqabatee labsii yeroo ariifachiisaa labseera. Hagayyaa jalqabaa kaasee namootni 3,300 ol ta'an odola kana ga'uun isaanii, tajaajila fayyaa fi qabeenya naannichaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera. Hogganootni naannichaa haalli kun kan itti fufuu hin dandeenye ta'uu ibsuun, mootummaan giddugaleessa Ispeen deeggarsa hatattamaa akka taasisuuf gaafataniiru.

title: Polish PM calls deadly Krakow shooting an act of ‘terrorism’
english: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has labeled a violent shooting incident in Krakow as an act of terrorism. The attack resulted in the deaths of six individuals and left 15 others injured. Additionally, authorities discovered three more bodies at the suspect's residence, which are believed to be those of his family members.
amharic: የፖላንድ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ዶናልድ ቱስክ በክራኮው ከተማ የደረሰውን ገዳይ የተኩስ ልውውጥ የሽብር ተግባር ሲሉ ገልጸውታል። ጥቃቱ ስድስት ሰዎችን ለህልፈት የዳረገ ሲሆን ሌሎች 15 ሰዎች ደግሞ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በተጨማሪም ባለስልጣናት በተጠርጣሪው ቤት ውስጥ የቤተሰቡ አባላት ናቸው ተብለው የሚጠረጠሩ ሶስት ተጨማሪ አስከሬኖች ተገኝተዋል።
oromo: Muummeen Ministiraa Poolaand Donaald Tuusk miidhaa dhukaasaa magaalaa Kraakoow keessatti raawwatamee fi lubbuu darbe akka gocha shororkeessummaa tokkootti ibsaniiru. Dhukaasa kanaan namoonni ja’a du’anii 15 ammoo madaa’aniiru. Kana malees, qaamoleen nageenyaa mana shakkamaa sanaa keessatti reeffa namoota sadii kanneen miseensa maatii isaa ta’uu malu jedhamee shakkamu argataniiru.

title: Iran war live: Blasts heard in Qeshm; US moves to block land supply routes
english: Explosions have been reported across several Iranian locations, including Qeshm Island and various coastal cities near the Strait of Hormuz. In response to rising tensions, the United States has launched a new task force aimed at cutting off Iran's land supply chains. This initiative expands upon existing American efforts to restrict Iranian maritime trade in the region.
amharic: በኢራን የሆርሙዝ ባህር ወሽመጥ አቅራቢያ በሚገኙ የቃሽም ደሴት እና ሌሎች የባህር ዳርቻ ከተሞች ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ የሀገሪቱ የመገናኛ ብዙኃን ዘግበዋል። ለዚህም ምላሽ አሜሪካ የኢራንን የመሬት አቅርቦት መስመሮች ለመዝጋት የሚያስችል አዲስ እቅድ ይፋ አድርጋለች። ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል በባህር ላይ ሲያደርጉት የነበረውን ማዕቀብ የበለጠ የሚያጠናክር ነው።
oromo: Magaalota Iran kanneen akka qarqara galaana Hormuz fi qe'ee Qeshm keessatti dhoohaan guddaan dhaga'ameera jedhamee gabaafameera. Haala kanaan walqabatee, Ameerikaan daandiiwwan gurguddaa Iran gara lafaa fayyadamtu cufuuf karoorri haaraan akka ba'e ibsiteetti. Tarkaanfiin kunis uggura Ameerikaan bishaan irra tursiifte cimsanii itti fufuuf kan karoorfameedha.

title: Eisenkot chosen over Netanyahu to form Israel’s next government
english: Israel's president has selected opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to organize the country's upcoming government instead of the incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. This decision highlights a significant political shift, as diverse political factions have unified in their opposition to Netanyahu's leadership. The move marks a major change in the Israeli political landscape as they move toward forming a new administration.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፕሬዚዳንት የአገሪቱን ቀጣይ መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ ከተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት ጋር መግባባት ላይ ደርሰዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንያሚን ኔታንያሁ አስተዳደር ጋር የተለየ አቋም ያላቸው የተለያዩ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎች በመቀናጀታቸው የተገኘ ውጤት ነው። ይህ እርምጃ አዲስ መንግስት ለመመስረት በሚደረገው ጥረት በእስራኤል ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ትልቅ ለውጥን ያሳያል።
oromo: Pirezidantiin Israa'el mootummaa biyyattii itti aanu akka hundeessan hoggantoota mormituu keessaa Gadii Ayizenkootiif carraa kennaniiru. Murteen kun kan agarsiisu, gareeleen siyaasaa adda addaa gita-bitoota Benjamin Neetanyaahutti mormuu isaanii irraa kan ka'e tokkummaan dhaabbachuu isaanii ti. Tarkaanfiin kun biyyattii keessatti mootummaa haaraa hundeessuuf jijjiirama siyaasaa guddaa geessiseera.

title: French ships may escort pro-Palestinian civilian flotillas, Mélenchon says
english: French politician Jean-Luc Mélenchon has proposed using French ships to escort civilian flotillas aiming to provide aid to Palestinians. He stated this initiative is intended to oppose the ongoing violence in Gaza and the annexation of territories like the West Bank and southern Lebanon. Mélenchon emphasized his commitment to taking direct action to protect these regions and support persecuted communities in the area.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ ፖለቲከኛ ዣን-ሉክ ሜለንቾን ወደ ፍልስጤም እርዳታ የሚያደርሱ የሲቪል መርከቦችን የፈረንሳይ የባህር ኃይል እንዲያጅብ ሐሳብ አቅርበዋል። ይህ እርምጃ በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት እንዲሁም የዌስት ባንክ እና የደቡብ ሊባኖስ ግዛቶችን መያዝ ለመቃወም የታለመ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። ሜለንቾን እነዚህን ክልሎች ለመጠበቅ እና ችግር ላይ ያሉ ማህበረሰቦችን ለመደገፍ ቀጥተኛ እርምጃዎችን እንደሚወስድ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Poliitikaan biyya Faransaay Zhaan-Luuk Meelenchoon, markaboolee namoota sivilii gara Falasxiin gargaarsa geessan hordofuu fi eeguuf markaboota Faransaay fayyadamuuf yaada dhiyeessaniiru. Tarkaanfichi kun waraana Gaazaa keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru akkasumas dhuunfannaa lafa Weest Baankii fi Kibba Liibaanoos mormuuf kan kaayyeffatedha. Meelenchoon naannolee kana eeguuf akkasumas hawaasa rakkoo keessa jiru gargaaruuf tarkaanfii qabatamaa fudhachuuf murteeffachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: 'You lost war and election': Iran's Rezaei warns US of 'devastating response'
english: Major General Mohsen Rezaei, a high-ranking Iranian security official, has issued a stern warning to the United States regarding future military aggression. In a recent statement, he criticized the current state of the U.S. leadership and political landscape while threatening a severe military reaction if hostilities recommence. Rezaei emphasized that any attempt to start a new war would be met with a destructive counterattack from Iran.
amharic: የኢራን ከፍተኛ የጸጥታ ምክር ቤት ጸሐፊ ሜጀር ጀነራል ሞህሰን ረዛኢ በአሜሪካ ላይ አዲስ ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ቢሰነዘር ጠንካራ ምላሽ እንደሚሰጡ አስጠንቅቀዋል። በአሜሪካ ወቅታዊ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ላይ ትችታቸውን የሰነዘሩት ረዛኢ፣ ሀገሪቱ ጦርነት ከጀመረች ኢራን እጅግ አውዳሚ የሆነ አጸፋዊ ምላሽ እንደምትሰጥ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ማስጠንቀቂያ የተሰጠው አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የምታደርገውን ማንኛውንም አይነት የጦርነት ቅስቀሳ ለመከላከል ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan nageenyaa ol'aanaa Iiraan, Mejeer Jeneraal Mohsen Rezaa'ii, yoo Ameerikaan lola haaraa jalqabde tarkaanfii cimaa fi miidhaa geessisu akka fudhatan akeekkachiisaniiru. Hogganaan kun haala siyaasaa Ameerikaa keessa jiru qeequun, mootummaan Ameerikaa lola keessa seenee akka hin mufanneef jechuun ergaa cimaa dabarsaniiru. Iiraan lola kamiyyuu akka gaariitti of irraa ittisuuf qophiidha jechuun ibsaniiru.

title: Centcom sets up 'Task Force Iron Gate' to disrupt Iran’s weapons transfers
english: The U.S. Central Command has launched 'Task Force Iron Gate' to intercept Iranian weapons and sanctioned goods moving across land borders and the Caspian Sea. Based in Florida, this group of 20 personnel will work with other government agencies to cut off illicit funding and military supply chains. This initiative builds on existing maritime blockades to further restrict Iran's ability to support regional proxies and military expansion.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ሴንትኮም (Centcom) ኢራን በመሬት እና በካስፒያን ባህር በኩል የምታደርገውን የጦር መሳሪያና ህገ-ወጥ ቁሳቁስ ዝውውር ለመግታት 'ታስክ ፎርስ አይረን ጌት' የተሰኘ አዲስ ቡድን አቋቋመ። በፍሎሪዳ የሚገኘው ይህ የሃያ ባለሙያዎች ቡድን፣ ሌሎች የመንግስት ተቋማት ጋር በመተባበር የኢራንን የገንዘብ እና የጦር መሳሪያ አቅርቦት ለማቋረጥ ይሰራል። ይህ እርምጃ ቀደም ሲል በባህር ላይ ሲደረግ የነበረውን እገዳ በማጠናከር የኢራንን ወታደራዊ አቅም የመገደብ ዓላማ አለው።
oromo: Ajajni giddugaleessa Ameerikaa (Centcom) meeshaalee waraanaa fi meeshaalee dhorkaman daangaa lafaa fi galaana Kaspian irraan dabarsuu Iran ittisuuf 'Task Force Iron Gate' kan jedhamu garee haaraa hundeessuu isaa beeksisera. Gareen kun qondaaltoota 20 of keessatti qabatuun, kan hundaa'e Florida keessatti yoo ta'u, dhaabbilee mootummaa biroo wajjin ta'uun gargaarsa mallaqaa fi dhiyeessii waraanaa Iran itti fufiinsaan ittisuuf hojjata. Hojiin kun, ittisa galaana irraatiin booda, dandeettii Iran kan waraanaa fi kan maallaqaa daangessuuf gumaacha guddaa qaba.

title: Yemen and Lebanon to work towards halting Hezbollah support for Houthis, minister says
english: Yemen's foreign minister announced plans to work with Lebanese officials to stop Hezbollah from assisting Houthi military operations. Both countries aim to improve cooperation to ensure national sovereignty and security while preventing foreign interference in their internal affairs. This diplomatic effort seeks to strengthen ties between the two nations through mutual respect and shared regional stability goals.
amharic: የየመን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሄዝቦላህ ለሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሚያደርገውን ድጋፍ ለማስቆም ከሊባኖስ ባለስልጣናት ጋር በጋራ ለመስራት መስማማታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ሁለቱ ሀገራት የየራሳቸውን ሉዓላዊነት እና ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ እንዲሁም የውጭ ጣልቃ ገብነትን ለመከላከል የቅርብ ትብብር ለማድረግ አቅደዋል። ይህ ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ጥረት በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለውን ግንኙነት በማጠናከር ቀጣናዊ ሰላምን ለማምጣት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri dhimma alaa Yaman, gareen Hizbollah gocha waraana Hutiif deeggarsa akka hin goone dhaabsisuuf mootummaa Libaanoos waliin hojjechuuf walii galuu isaanii ibsan. Biyyoonni lameen kun kabaja fi nageenya biyyoolessaa isaanii eeggachuu akkasumas giddugalummaa alaa ittisuuf waliin hojjechuuf karoorfataniiru. Carraaqqiin diippilomaasii kun walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lameenii cimsuudhaan nagaa naannichaa mirkaneessuuf kan gargaaruudha.

title: Death toll from air strikes near Yemeni capital rises to 33, Houthis say
english: Air strikes on a village near Sanaa, Yemen, have resulted in at least 33 deaths and 39 injuries, according to Houthi officials. The attacks hit residential homes and reportedly killed mostly women and children. Rescue operations have been hindered because the area continues to be targeted, resulting in casualties even among medical personnel.
amharic: የሁቲ ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት በየመን ዋና ከተማ ሰንዓ አቅራቢያ በሚገኝ መንደር በተፈጸመ የአየር ጥቃት ቢያንስ 33 ሰዎች መሞታቸውንና 39 መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ጥቃቱ የመኖሪያ ቤቶችን ኢላማ ያደረገ ሲሆን በአብዛኛው ሴቶችና ህጻናት ለህልፈት ተዳርገዋል። አካባቢው ላይ ጥቃቱ ተደጋግሞ በመፈጸሙ የነፍስ አድን ስራዎች የተስተጓጎሉ ሲሆን የህክምና ባለሙያዎችም ጭምር በግጭቱ ተጎድተዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Huutii akka ibsanitti, magaalaa guddoo Yaman Sana’aa biratti miidhagaalee bakka buufatameen namoonni 33 lubbuun darbanii 39 immoo madaa’aniiru. Haleellaan kun manneen jireenyaa kan rukute yoo ta’u, miidhamtoota keessaa baay’een isaanii dubartoota fi ijoollee dha. Haleellaan kun itti fufuun isaa hojii gargaarsa hatattamaa danqee, ogeeyyiin fayyaa illee miidhaa irra ga’eera.

title: Israel's president tasks opposition leader Eisenkot with forming government
english: Israeli President Isaac Herzog has officially asked opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot to form a new government following the recent inconclusive election results. Although no single party secured a majority, Eisenkot received more parliamentary recommendations than incumbent Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Eisenkot now has four weeks to build a governing coalition, a difficult task given the fragmented nature of the Israeli parliament.
amharic: የእስራኤል ፕሬዚዳንት ይስሐቅ ሄርዞግ በቅርቡ በተካሄደው ምርጫ አሸናፊ ባለመኖሩ ምክንያት የተቃዋሚው መሪ ጋዲ አይዘንኮት አዲስ መንግስት እንዲመሰርቱ ስልጣን ሰጥተዋል። ምንም እንኳን የትኛውም ፓርቲ አብላጫ ድምፅ ባያገኝም፣ አይዘንኮት ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ቤንጃሚን ኔታንያሁ በበለጠ የተመራጮች ድጋፍ አግኝተዋል። በዚህም መሰረት አይዘንኮት የተበታተነውን የፓርላማ ድርድር በማስተባበር ጥምር መንግስት ለመመስረት የ28 ቀናት ጊዜ ተሰጥቷቸዋል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Israa'el Isaak Herzoog bu'aan filannoo waan hin iftoomneef, gaggeessaan mormituu Gaadii Aayizenkoot mootummaa haaraa akka hundeessan gaafataniiru. Paartiin tokko illee sagalee caalmaa waan hin arganneef, Aayizenkoot muummicha ministeeraa kan ta'an Beenjaamiin Nataanyaahuurra deeggarsa baay'ee argataniiru. Aayizenkoot amma paartilee siyaasaa walii galchuun mootummaa hundeessuuf guyyoota 28 qabu.

title: Real Madrid beat Valencia 3-0 to draw level with La Liga leaders Barcelona
english: Real Madrid secured a dominant 3-0 victory over Valencia, with goals from Federico Valverde, Arda Guler, and Kylian Mbappé. This win marks the team's eighth consecutive victory, allowing them to temporarily match Barcelona's point total at the top of the La Liga table. Mbappé continued his impressive form by scoring in his seventh straight match to seal the win.
amharic: ሪያል ማድሪድ ቫሌንሺያን 3 ለ 0 በማሸነፍ በላሊጋው አናት ላይ ካለው ባርሴሎና ጋር ነጥብ ተጋርተዋል። የድል ግቦቹን ፈዴሪኮ ቫልቬርዴ፣ አርዳ ጉለር እና ኪሊያን ምባፔ ያስቆጠሩ ሲሆን፣ ቡድኑ በሁሉም ውድድሮች ያለውን ተከታታይ የድል ጉዞ ወደ ስምንት ከፍ አድርጓል። ምባፔም በተከታታይ በሰባተኛው ጨዋታ ግብ በማስቆጠር ጥሩ ብቃቱን አሳይቷል።
oromo: Real Madrid tapha Valencia irratti 3-0 injifachuun, qabxii isaa La Liga irratti Barcelona wajjin qixxeessera. Galchoota kunneen Federico Valverde, Arda Guler fi Kylian Mbappe kan galchanii yoo ta'u, kunis taphataan kun dorgommiiwwan hunda irratti walitti aansuun injifannoo saddeettaffaa akka galmeessu isa taasiseera. Mbappe tapha torba walitti aansuun galchuu danda'uun qormaata guddaa agarsiiseera.

title: Police clash with protesters as anti-government rallies sweep France
english: Protesters known as the Yellow Vests engaged in confrontations with police in Paris after defying a ban on their demonstration. At least 146,000 people marched across France for the fourth consecutive week to voice their frustration over the rising cost of living. Authorities arrested two movement leaders as the rallies continued to sweep through the country.
amharic: የቢጫ ጃኬት ለባሾች የተባሉ ተቃዋሚዎች የተጣለባቸውን የሰልፍ እገዳ በመተላለፋቸው በፓሪስ ከፖሊስ ጋር ተጋጭተዋል። በፈረንሳይ ያሉ ቢያንስ 146,000 ሰዎች የኑሮ ውድነትን በመቃወም ለተከታታይ አራተኛ ሳምንት አደባባይ ወጥተዋል። በሰልፉ ወቅትም የተቃውሞ እንቅስቃሴውን ሲመሩ የነበሩ ሁለት ግለሰቦች በፖሊስ ቁጥጥር ስር ውለዋል።
oromo: Hiriirtonni 'Yellow Vests' jedhaman dhowwii gocha hiriiraa cabsanii bahuun isaaniin, magaalaa Paariis keessatti poolisoota wajjin walitti bu'iinsi uumameera. Namoonni 146,000 ol ta'an gatiin jireenyaa dabaluu isaatiin mufatanii torban afurffaadhaaf guutuu Faransaay keessatti hiriira bahaniiru. Walitti bu'iinsa kana keessatti hoogganoonni hiriiraa lama poolisaan qabamaniiru.

title: Mélenchon promises action against Israeli annexation if elected President
english: French presidential candidate Jean-Luc Mélenchon has committed to taking a firm stance against Israeli policies in Palestinian territories if he wins the election. He specifically pledged to oppose the annexation of the West Bank and the ongoing conflict in Gaza. His campaign promises focus on providing stronger support for the Palestinian cause through direct government action.
amharic: የፈረንሳይ የፕሬዚዳንት እጩ ዣን-ሉክ ሜለንቾን ወደ ስልጣን ከመጡ በእስራኤል የፖሊሲ እርምጃዎች ላይ ጠንካራ አቋም እንደሚወስዱ ቃል ገብተዋል። በተለይም በዌስት ባንክ የሚደረገውን መሬት የመቀላቀል እንቅስቃሴ እና በጋዛ ያለውን ግጭት እንደሚቃወሙ አስታውቀዋል። የዘመቻው ዋና ትኩረትም በፍልስጤማውያን ጉዳይ ላይ ተጨባጭ የመንግስት ድጋፍ ማድረግ ነው።
oromo: Kaadhimamaan pirezidaantummaa Faransaay Zhaan-Luuk Meelenchoon, yoo filataman imaammata Israa'eel kanneen naannoo Falasxiin irratti fudhataman mormuuf waadaa galaniiru. Keessattuu, qabiyyee lafa Gadaa Lixaa fi waraana Gaazaa keessatti adeemsifamaa jiru mormuuf dhaadataniiru. Kaayyoon isaanii inni guddaan gocha mootummaan Falasxiinotaaf deeggarsa qabatamaa taasisuu dha.

title: Who is behind Europe’s suspected hybrid attacks?
english: European nations are facing a surge of disruptive hybrid attacks, including false bomb threats that have paralyzed airports and cyberattacks targeting supermarket cooling systems. These incidents have sparked widespread security concerns regarding the vulnerability of vital civilian infrastructure across the continent. Authorities are now investigating whether these separate acts are part of a coordinated campaign and are working to determine who is responsible.
amharic: የአውሮፓ አገራት በአየር ማረፊያዎች ላይ በሚደረጉ የሐሰት የቦምብ ማስፈራሪያዎችና በሱፐርማርኬቶች ላይ በሚቃጡ የሳይበር ጥቃቶች ምክንያት ከፍተኛ ስጋት ውስጥ ወድቀዋል። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች የሲቪል መሠረተ ልማቶችን ደህንነት አደጋ ላይ ጥለዋል። ባለሥልጣናት እነዚህ ተከታታይ ጥቃቶች የተቀናጀ ዘመቻ መሆናቸውን እና ከዚህ በስተጀርባ ማን እንዳለ ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Biyyoonni Awurooppaa xiyyaaraafi suuqiiwwan gurguddaa irratti haleellaa suuraa garaagaraa kanneen akka sossobbiin boombii fi haleellaa saayibarii irratti gaggeeffamaa jiruun yaaddoo nageenyaa keessa galaniiru. Haleellaawwan kun bu'uuraalee misoomaa hawaasummaa biyyattii miidhaa jiru. Qondaalonni mootummaa haleellaawwan kunneen walitti hidhata qabaachuu fi namoota kana duuba jiran adda baasuuf qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Abdul El-Sayed slams Trump’s tariff war with Canada
english: Newly elected Michigan Senator Abdul El-Sayed has publicly criticized Donald Trump's tariff policies regarding Canada. He argued that these trade barriers ultimately harm American consumers by driving up the prices of Canadian products. El-Sayed shared these concerns during a recent appearance on the Pod Save America podcast.
amharic: አዲስ የተመረጡት የሚቺጋን ሴናተር አብዱል ኤል-ሳዬድ በካናዳ ላይ የተጣለውን የዶናልድ ትራምፕ የንግድ ታሪፍ ተቃውመዋል። እነዚህ የንግድ ገደቦች የካናዳ ምርቶች ዋጋ እንዲጨምሩ በማድረግ በመጨረሻ የአሜሪካ ሸማቾችን እንደሚጎዱ ገልጸዋል። ሴናተሩ ይህንን ሃሳብ የገለጹት በቅርቡ በፖድ ሴቭ አሜሪካ ፖድካስት ላይ በነበራቸው ቆይታ ነው።
oromo: Senatorichi Michigan haaraa filataman Abdul El-Sayed, imaammata taarifa daldalaa Donald Trump kan biyya Kaanaadaa irratti qaban mormaniiru. Taarifiin kun gatii meeshaalee Kaanaadaa ol kaasuun walumaagalatti gabaastota Ameerikaa miidha jiru jedhaniiru. El-Sayed yaada kana kan ibsan sagantaa 'Pod Save America' jedhamu irratti dhihaatanii dha.

title: US military says it disabled cargo vessel in Gulf of Oman
english: The US military used precision fire to disable a cargo ship after it attempted to bypass a naval blockade following a visit to an Iranian port. In a broader effort to enforce sanctions, the US is also establishing a new task force to intercept illegal arms shipments across Iran's land and sea borders. Officials estimate that these ongoing blockade efforts have successfully blocked Iran from exporting over $25 billion in crude oil.
amharic: የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ ኃይል ኢራንን የወደብ ጉብኝት አድርጎ የባህር ማገጃውን ለመጣስ የሞከረ የጭነት መርከብ ላይ ጥቃት በመሰንዘር እንዲቆም አድርጓል። አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ የጣለችውን ማዕቀብ ለማስፈጸም የጦር መሳሪያ ዝውውርን ለመቆጣጠር የሚያስችል አዲስ ግብረ ኃይል አቋቁማለች። እስከ አሁን ባለው የባህር ማገጃ ስራ ኢራን ከ25 ቢሊዮን ዶላር በላይ የሚገመት ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ ወደ ውጭ እንዳትልክ መከላከል መቻሉን የአሜሪካ የጦር መምሪያ አስታውቋል።
oromo: Waraanni Ameerikaa markabii fe'umsaa buufata Iran dhaqee deebi'uun dhoorka galaanaa inni kaa'e cabsuuf yaalii goote rukutuun akka dhaabatu godheera. Ameerikaan tarkaanfii kanaan cinaatti, gurgurtaa meeshaalee waraanaa seeraan alaa fi sanadaalee dhoorkaman to'achuuf garee addaa haarawa ijaaruu ishee beeksisite. Hojiin dhoorka galaanaa kun hanga ammaatti Iran boba'aa dachaasaa gatiin isaa biliyoona 25 doolaraa ol ta'u gurguruu akka hin dandeenye taasiseera.

title: Iran's army says forces 'stronger' than at start of war, Hormuz to stay closed
english: The Iranian military claims it is more powerful and prepared than at the start of the current conflict, vowing to keep the Strait of Hormuz closed until its demands are satisfied. Officials have signaled their intent to defend national sovereignty with increased missile capabilities while engaging in diplomatic outreach across the region. Meanwhile, the United States is pushing to curb Iran's nuclear development by offering financial rewards for information related to the country's nuclear program.
amharic: የኢራን ወታደራዊ አመራሮች አገራቸው አሁን ከጀመረው ጦርነት መጀመሪያ ይልቅ በጠንካራ አቋም ላይ እንደምትገኝ በመግለጽ፣ የሆርሙዝ የባህር በር ፍላጎታቸው እስኪሟላ ድረስ ተዘግቶ እንደሚቆይ አስታውቀዋል። የኢራን ባለስልጣናት የአገራቸውን ሉዓላዊነት ለመከላከል ሚሳኤሎቻቸውን እያሳደጉ መሆናቸውን የገለጹ ሲሆን፣ በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድም ከአካባቢው አገራት ጋር ውይይት እያደረጉ ነው። በሌላ በኩል፣ አሜሪካ የኢራንን የኑክሌር ፕሮግራም ለመግታት መረጃ ለሚሰጡ ሰዎች የገንዘብ ሽልማት በመስጠት ጥረቷን አጠናክራ ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Raayyaan ittisa biyyaa Iraan waraana kana keessatti amma irra caalaa humna cimaa fi qophii ta'uu ishee ibsuun, hanga gaaffiin isaanii guututti daandiin galaana Hormuz cufaa akka ta'u beeksisan. Mootummaan Iraan of ittisuuf meeshaalee waraanaa fi misayiloota ishee jabeeffachaa jiru, gama biraatiin immoo biyyoota ollaa waliin marii diplomaasii taasisuu itti fufaniiru. Gamasaatiin, mootummaan Ameerikaa sagantaa niwukilaraa Iraan daangessuuf, odeeffannoo kennaniif badhaasa maallaqaa qopheessuun ishee beekameera.

title: Explosions reported on Iran's Qeshm Island and in port of Jask
english: Local media reported explosions in Iran's Qeshm Island and the port of Jask on Saturday, though authorities have not yet confirmed the cause. While one agency mentioned the possibility of missile strikes, no group has claimed responsibility for the incident. These reports follow recent limited military actions conducted by the United States in the region.
amharic: ቅዳሜ ዕለት በኢራን የቀሽም ደሴት እና የጃስክ ወደብ አካባቢ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ የአካባቢው መገናኛ ብዙኃን ዘግበዋል። ምንም እንኳን አንዳንድ ምንጮች ሚሳኤሎች ተተኩሰው ሊሆን እንደሚችል ቢገልጹም፣ መንግሥት እስካሁን ስለ ፍንዳታው ምክንያቶች ይፋዊ ማብራሪያ አልሰጠም። ይህ ክስተት የተከሰተው አሜሪካ በክልሉ ውስጥ ውስን ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎችን ከወሰደች ከጥቂት ቀናት በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Dilbata darbe gabaasawwan miidiyaaleen akka ibsanitti, qarqara galaana Iran kan ta'e ganda Qeshm fi buufata Jask keessatti dhukaatin dhagahameera. Haa ta'u malee, sababa dhukaatii kanaa irratti mootummaan Iran hanga ammaatti ifatti waan ibse hin jiru. Gabaasni kun kan dhufu, qilleensarraa tarkaanfiin muraasni Ameerikaan naannichatti erga raawwattee guyyoota muraasa booda.

title: Saudi Arabia lifts alert in Jazan, home to Aramco refinery targeted by Houthis
english: Saudi authorities have removed a safety alert in the Jazan region following concerns over potential security threats. This area is strategically significant as it houses a major Aramco oil refinery. The region has frequently faced drone and missile strikes from Houthi rebels due to its proximity to the ongoing conflict in Yemen.
amharic: የሳዑዲ አረቢያ የሲቪል መከላከያ ባለስልጣናት በጃዛን ግዛት ላይ ጥለውት የነበረውን የደህንነት ማስጠንቀቂያ አንስተዋል። አካባቢው ትልቅ የአራምኮ የነዳጅ ማጣሪያ የሚገኝበት በመሆኑ ወሳኝ ቦታ ነው። በየመን ያለው ግጭት ከተቀሰቀሰበት ጊዜ ጀምሮ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በዚሁ ክልል በሚገኙ የኢነርጂ መሠረተ ልማቶች ላይ ተደጋጋሚ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃቶችን ሲሰነዝሩ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii Arabaa ergaa akeekkachiisaa naannoo Jazanirratti labsame ture erga tasgabbii booda kaaseera. Naannichi qabeenya gurguddaa kanneen akka iddoo daaddoo boba'aa Aramkoo waan of keessaa qabuuf bakka hambaalee sodaachisaa turee dha. Naannichi daangaa Yamanitti dhiyoo waan ta'eef, waraana Yaman keessatti geggeeffamuun walqabatee gareen Huutii dronii fi misayilootaan yeroo garagaraa haleelaa ture.
